title: Yoisaki Kanade — Card Story

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to change the feel of the hook, so if I shift the pitch at this part...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(The sound of my growling stomach...
I only ate a little in the morning.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This is hopeless... It just won't stop growling...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have no choice. I'll eat some dinner.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Let me boil water for the instant noodles...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The disposable chopsticks should be somewhere here.)

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <K, are you there? I'm starting work early today.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Huh? I hear a sizzling sound...
Are you boiling water?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<But it fills my stomach.
Oh... The water's boiled...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Hey, K! I've finished the illustrations for the next song. Can you take a look?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Wait, Enanan.
K's having dinner right now.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Huh, she is? Okay, I'll send it later, then.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<No. Finish your dinner first, okay?
Once you start checking, you'll forget about everything else.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yeah. The other day, you completely forgot about your instant noodles while checking Amia's video, too.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <That's why you should eat first before that happens again.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <True, the noodles tasted terrible the next morning...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <What?! So you ate it in the end...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Good. Wait... K, today...
I mean, it's technically the next day already, but did you have lunch today?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<That's no good, K.
You should definitely eat something, even if it's just a snack or some pastries.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Evening! Actually, I've been here for some time already, but I was talking while still muted.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Well, that's just silly. Are you even awake?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Well, after all, unlike a certain someone I know, I woke up bright and early this morning to go to school properly.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Excuse me? I'll have you know I went to school, too.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<After waking up in the evening, right?
Must be nice to be on a part-time course.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<It's been two minutes and 53 seconds...
Enanan, I'll finish the noodles quickly, so just send the illustrations over.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Right... I was looking for chopsticks.
Let's see...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Sigh... I have to go to the kitchen to get them. Forget the noodles. I'll just eat an energy bar.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <What?! But you already poured water inside, right?!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <You really shouldn't waste food like that...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Fine... I'll go get chopsticks from the kitchen for the noodles, as much of a hassle as it is...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to refine this bass line a bit more...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's still light out. I'll finish it before everyone comes on.)

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Most of the high schools in this area are having exams now, so I think Amia may come on earlier, too.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Okay. That's must be why she said she would be coming in the afternoon today.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yes. She helps to clean the house and do other housework. Is that strange?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<It's not strange... More like unusual?
It's not every day you hear of someone with a part-time housekeeper.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Well. I didn't think you were the sort to allow strangers into your house.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <But you don't want people touching your equipment, right?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <She checked with me on the first day what are the things she could touch and what to stay away from.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Wow, that's really professional of her.
What sort of person is she?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Apparently so.
I heard they're usually housewives.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <She's a part-timer who just so happened to sign up for the job, but she's really good at her work.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <By the way, Yuki, how's your progress with the lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I just hope they match the image of the melody line that you gave me.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Haha. That puts a lot of pressure on me!>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Just keep doing what you've been doing. Enanan's pictures, Amia's videos, and your lyrics... They're never too far off from the image of the song.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Hey, did you approach us because you thought we would just go along with the things you had in mind?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<No.
It's because I felt like we all seemed alike somehow.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yuki, show me what you've already written for the lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Mind if I try calling you by your real name?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Why would you want to do that?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Did it feel any different? You must have had a reason for wanting to use my real name instead of my handle.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't know, it just came over me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah. I want to know more about you, and Ena, and Mizuki too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I created Nightcord at 25:00 because I wanted to make music that some people might enjoy.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I thought it didn't really matter who I was collaborating with as long as everyone knew how to do their part.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Since talking to you in Miku's SEKAI, I realized I wanted to get to know you all better.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Because you want our group to stick together, making songs that will make people happy?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's only one part of the reason.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't know if that's the right way to put it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I think I just...want to be friends with you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Maybe I want to learn more about you guys because we share a destiny.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Hehe, that makes more sense to me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<So, Mafuyu...
Tell me more about yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <How can I tell you about myself when I don't really know what I am?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You know how when you study, sometimes the way to understand something better is to try to explain it to someone else?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But, for example, I couldn't even tell you why I laughed just now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I just have this need to know more about you, so tell me anything. Describe your room to me.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My room, huh. I'm sitting at my desk, and next to me are my textbooks, a dictionary, and a book.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Just something I borrowed from the library. I have to return it soon.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Do you go to the library often?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Not really. I borrowed this book because we had to read it for one class.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Back to my room, there's a bed, a closet, the usual. And a fish tank.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I just have some sand and aquatic plants in it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And what do you use it for?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Nothing. I just like to space out looking at the plants swaying in the water.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So? You got me all figured out now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But you know what? This was the first time we talked at length about something other than music.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It might be nice to do it again sometime.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Alright, that's it for the night.
Yaaawn! I'm going to log off and lie down.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm barely awake too. Sleepy time for me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Can I just ask you something before we log off?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Have you decided what you're going to order? I'm getting cola and large fries!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I'll have...this limited edition dessert.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Of course you're going for that. It's gonna look good on your social media, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you care? Press the button and let's order.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway...
Kanade, what's this offline meeting for?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I didn't have any special agenda for it.
I just thought it might be nice to meet up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Knowing each other better might help us make better songs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um... I get it about wanting to make better music, but... You called us out here to socialize?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, I'm kinda happy you did.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that you're showing a real interest in us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Normally, all you care about is music and making new songs.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd like to get to know you better too, Kanade. Can we ask you personal questions?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yay! First, to get started, let me tell you a bit about myself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
She's got a brother one year younger than us.
He's a bit cocky but does anything Ena says like a good boy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Why are you butting in!?
And you're just telling everyone about Akito, not me!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So your brother's name is Akito?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Guess what, he does music too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's interesting to me too.
I don't have any siblings, so I don't know what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
So, Akito's my younger brother, like Mizuki said...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We like and dislike the same foods.
So we both like cheesecake and can't stand carrots.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which is weird because in all other aspects we're very unlike one another.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh, you have such wholesome family relationships. I haven't even seen my sister in a long time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she's way older than me and lives abroad, so I don't really see her much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We can text each other whenever, but I don't even remember when the last time we did that was.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In case you were wondering, my favorite foods are curry rice and fries!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I always tell people it's my mom's cooking.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's what you tell people, but is it really?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't really know what flavors I like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
You like the stuff that tastes good to you, simple as that, no?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The thing is, I can't really tell what food tastes like. Like if it's good or bad.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?!
How does that even work?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But, like, you can tell when something is salty, or what sort of texture it has, right? Try one of my fries and describe what you feel!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's fine. I'm not going to eat them until they cool down a bit anyway, I'm sensitive to hot foods.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So Ena and Mizuki have siblings, and Mafuyu doesn't know what foods she likes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Kanade! Have some of my fries!
Careful, though, they're really hot!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
How did you find today's dinner?
Was it to your liking?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It was delicious.
It's more like breakfast for me, though.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You hadn't eaten anything since you woke up, again?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I tend to forget when I'm working.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you really need to eat proper meals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
By the way, there's dessert today too.
Do you still have space for some apple pie?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I'll be working late into the night, so I want to eat as much as I can now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here you go.
If you don't mind, I'd like to take a little piece as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad you like it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ms. Mochizuki has a kind smile, but her eyes seem so sad... Just like my father's...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Is there perhaps something troubling her as well?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku. I don't want these people in my world.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you ever thought of wanting to...disappear?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... Yes. A little bit, sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, okay. I'm sorry...
That was a strange thing to ask.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Don't be.
I asked you first.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Well, in that case...
Could I ask you one more thing?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What do you do...when you start having such thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.
The tea was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The apple pie was good too.
I would love to have it again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki. I've made a demo of the song up to the hook. Can you listen to it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Phew!
I'm more or less done with the illustrations too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I've just finished a good portion of the video as well.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, can we all take a short breather?
There's something I want to talk to everyone about.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't mind, but what's this about?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yup!
Does everyone want to go watch this movie together?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?
This is a movie of a really obscure anime, isn't it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You want us to make a special trip down to see it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Obscure or not, I like it!
Though, it's true only a few movie theaters are screening it, and only at night...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <This movie director's previous film was pretty good.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I received a lot of inspiration from it for my songs.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<See, see?
Watching a movie can help with our songs!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <If we all watch the same movie, we can discuss it together, and that may become a good inspiration for us.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hm... Well, if K's going, I'll think about it too...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We're already in the tweaking stage for our current song, and you'll need inspiration for the next song, won't you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I can smell your desperation all the way here, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <None of my other friends seem interested, that's why.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I could totally go by myself, but I wanna talk about the movie with someone after that and share my thoughts!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't have a reason to say no, so why not.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay, let's decide on the date.
Which of these days is everyone free?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, what was the title of the previous movie you watched?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Ah... I'm curious about that too.
I'd love to watch a movie that K's watched before.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wow... I just read the synopsis and it's surprisingly interesting. I'll watch it before we meet.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'll watch it too.
Then I can compare it with the new one.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We've had more opportunities to meet and talk lately.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm sure this must be a good thing.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Right now, I'm not good enough to make a song that can save Yuki yet. So I have to keep absorbing new things.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So that I can compose better songs...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello. Am I to only clean the house for today as well?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Please do the kitchen and living room today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And...do you have some time to talk after that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We can chat over tea if you like.
I brought along some flavored teas with me today, too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let me get started on the cleaning, then.
I'll let you know once the tea is ready.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki, the tea is ready.
Shall we drink it before it gets cold?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
What a nice smell...
It's a different fragrance from the one we had the last time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I decided to go with muscat-flavored tea today. Do you like it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. This one is delicious too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, you wanted to talk about something?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I wanted to update you about the doll exhibition you gave me tickets for.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... That's right. How did it go?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was fun. There were a lot of different dolls on display. Also...it turned out to be a great help.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The person I was trying to help that I told you about... I invited her to join me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because of that, I feel like I understand her struggles and what's on her mind better now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, even though I won't be able to help her right now, I feel like I've taken a very important first step towards that goal.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This wouldn't have happened if you hadn't given me those tickets, so...thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, don't mention it at all! All I did was pass you a couple of tickets I had on hand.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm really glad to know they came in handy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Correct me if I'm wrong... But did you give me the tickets so that I could use them to create an opportunity to talk with my friend?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's just a feeling I have.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for being such a busybody.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Don't be. I'm glad I went to the exhibition.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I hope you don't mind me meddling one more time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please don't ever give up on your friend.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, I was feeling a little lost myself just a while ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But because my friends didn't give up on me, I managed to figure things out and move ahead again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Your friend... She may be feeling like there's no way out of whatever she's facing, but I'm confident of one thing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Somewhere deep inside, she's waiting for that someone who will never stop trying to reach out to her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll keep trying. Until I can save her one day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great work, everyone! We finally uploaded our new song!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on, Mizuki, who said you could run the show?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aw, what does it matter? Meeting together like this really drives home the fact that we've just finished a new song I can't help but feel happy about that♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We literally just met up the other day, though

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because not much time has passed since our last song.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Exactly! We've been creating quite a bit of buzz online because of that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The song we uploaded previously is still receiving a lot of views, huh? The one Kanade composed with the lyrics Mafuyu wrote.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. It looks like that song is on its way to becoming the video with the most views out of N25's videos.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which means Mafuyu's lyrics really struck a chord with a lot of people out there, then♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't understand how you can be so nonchalant about this. Did you see all those comments saying they identified with the lyrics or that it made them think deeper?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You read comments that aren't about your drawings, Ena? I'm impressed!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Did you read the comments, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I did. But I don't know how to feel about them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm not like you, Kanade.
I don't make songs because of other people.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I personally enjoy reading enthusiastic comments about my video editing, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me too. It cheers me up when I see someone complimenting my art. You've never felt like that before, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know, that someone understood the idea you were trying to convey with the lyrics...something like that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How did you feel about the lyrics, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Someone commented on the latest song about how they were encouraged by listening to it, despite its dark theme.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: When I saw that comment...I felt relieved.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because my music has hurt someone before, so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Very good! Clearly, everyone has their own way of interpreting the comments we received!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What about you, Mafuyu?
Managed to grasp anything?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay. Take your time to keep looking.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think you'll gradually start realizing things as you do. Things like how you feel about the comments you read.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I won't give up until you find it, too.
So let's look for it together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Your stomach just growled, didn't it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I haven't eaten anything yet today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know you're concerned about helping Mafuyu get back on her feet, but show some concern for yourself too, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey! The fries are here! Let's dig in together♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku, can you show us where Ena is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She may not want to talk. She wants to be alone and not see anyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What I can do for Ena right now is...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Me too♪ So you're really gonna make a song just for Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. What kind of song do you two think she needs right now...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I guess she needs to hear something like, “it's okay,” or, “you can do it,” in this song...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, there's one more thing. Enanan said she felt worried when she entered into that contest.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, you're entering into a contest?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a pretty big one too. Some of the other artists are practically pros too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean... I'm wondering if I can do a good job.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She was wondering if she can do a good job...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <“But my art's just an accessory for the song...”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, right. She did say that too...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You put no thought or effort into what you make, but you still get praise and attention...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She talks about innate talent every so often.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Enanan...
She thinks that she doesn't have any artistic talent, but I don't think so at all.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The first time I ever saw something she made, I was blown away and just kept staring.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The atmosphere and people in it had a dark and melancholy feel to it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But the message that, “we exist,” or, “we're right here,” also felt very clear.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. It felt like they were troubled by something and couldn't do anything about it on their own...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But at the same time they were trying to fight against the hand they were dealt to attain something greater.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. I get what you're trying to say, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So what are we going to do?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We still don't know anything about why Enanan is the way she is now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's true. It may be difficult to actually help her out or even find a solution.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But we can at least let her know that she's not alone.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah♪ Oh, also! What if the song's about letting Enanan know that we're there for her no matter where she goes?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hehe. That's also a good idea. Okay, what I'm thinking is...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Just hold on a little longer, Enanan. I'll make this song in no time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How's it going, K? Do you think you'll make it in time?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. Your ideas also helped work out the overall theme for this song, and there's just a little bit of adjusting left...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I came to see you, Kanade. You too, Mafuyu and Mizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I'm here to deliver your song to Ena in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Does that mean you'll sing for us...?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay, Rin. It's in your hands now. Please, find Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I hope it makes it to Enanan...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, are you two still free after this? I was hoping we could wait together until Rin gets back...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Staying up late is bad for the skin, but I guess we don't have a choice right now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for waiting, Enanan. I finished checking your artwork and I think what you came up with should work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, Enanan's never been this productive before. Is the world about to end or something?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What are you talking about? Anyways, I want to focus, so I'm putting everything on mute.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Fine, be that way. I was just having some fun...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I'm glad Enanan's back to her usual self.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Me too. She's taking Amia's jokes much better now too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, hold up. Why am I the bad guy all the sudden?! I'm not trying to be mean or anything!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that Ena feels better now. I need to thank Rin for delivering our song to her too.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I feel like Ena will be just fine now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But my art's just an accessory for the song...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Now that I think about it, I didn't explicitly say that she's wrong then...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Me three! So let's get started then♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, before we do...
Enanan, can you take a look at this?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Got it. Let's download and... Huh?
This is all stuff that I drew...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, it is! Wow, some of it's like a blast from the past too!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It is. These lines and brush strokes weren't very clean...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?! Why is it that you can only say stuff like that?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, settle down now. I get that you two want to talk, but K does too so...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you, Amia. Um, let's start by looking at the first one then.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, this one's from forever ago! You know, I never really get tired of seeing this girl and her floral hair piece.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. The girl's body is turned the other way, but the background and flowers on her hair piece make you think about what sort of expression she may have.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <This was from when we made that song that made very different impressions on each person that listened to it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That was why I wanted you to draw something that reflected that and also had the same effect. In the end, it matched perfectly with the song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I remember that I took too long designing the whole thing and made us upload later than usual.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, this was definitely worth the time. There's also...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The next file is... The boy that's vanishing with the rain, and how each rain drop represents the voices of the people around him, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. I really liked this one too and had a lot of fun while drawing it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Come to think of it, you were really on a roll that time and made a ton of other stuff too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um, I'm happy that you appreciate my art... But is this what you wanted me to see?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes... I thought that I should actually tell you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That your artwork isn't just an accessory.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I talked to Yuki and Amia about this earlier too...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Our songs can reach so many people because they have artwork that instantly tells them what they're about.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's why I thought I should tell you that your art makes our songs happen.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Of course it did... Thank you, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thanks. And sorry for the wait, Yuki, Amia. We should get started.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, it was fun to see this stuff again after so long♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<And Enanan...
We're definitely counting on you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Right. You can leave N25's artwork to me!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay, this works...
I'll do the rest on my end.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<We had so many fixes this time.
Yawn... Time for some well-earned rest.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, stop...! Before you all go, let's decide when we're gonna have our party!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What, already? You know it's not actually done yet, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, before we all forget♪ How does tomorrow sound? Maybe after Yuki gets out of cram school?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Tomorrow's the anniversary of my mother passing away.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then we should have our party some other time...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, I need to get everything ready for tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Incense, a lighter and...
Gloves, garbage bags and cleaning supplies...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Dad supposedly made this song because what he saw with mom on one their trips was too beautiful to forget...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They showed me some photos when I was little, but I can't really remember what they were of...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Those photos could still be in an album somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I found some albums, but no luck. They could still be hidden away somewhere else...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Looking for them might take a while...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should wrap things up with our song first. I need to come up with a demo for the next song too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I probably only have until morning at the latest.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's exactly as I imagined it too. Except the outro. I still have a few options left there...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'd like to ask everyone what they think, but I really doubt any of them will be up at this time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is there anyone else that I can...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (There's something bright over there. I wonder if that's Miku and the others...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But what's this? A ball of light...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's about the size of an apple. Where did this come from? It's too bright and hard to tell what's actually creating this light...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (More and more things have been appearing here lately, but nothing like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This place is made out of Mafuyu's feelings, so this could be another part of her as well...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It doesn't seem hot. Maybe I can touch it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
A field of flowers?
But I was in SEKAI just now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Is this the same SEKAI...?
I've never seen this place before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't see Miku or anyone else here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hold on... If I stop Untitled, maybe it'll send me back to my room...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess I don't have a choice. I'll just have to keep looking for everyone here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know where this is, but I hope I can get back somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've been walking for a while now, but it's just an endless field of flowers...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's like the first time I came to SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's beautiful, but so lonely and quiet...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (As if I'm the only one left on this planet...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (No, now's not the time for that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to find a way back soon. I need to visit mom's grave and work on our new song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm running out of ideas for how to get back...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Just white flowers as far as the eye can see... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Oh! Did you buy these for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Thank you. This makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? You're listening to daddy's music box again?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I really like looking at flowers while listening to the music box that your father made.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: That way, even when I'm at the hospital, it feels like you and your father are right here with me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Was it carnations that we put in mom's casket during her funeral...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I barely remember any of it since I was so little...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I recall that there wasn't a cloud in the sky as a line of smoke rose into the air...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That was when I knew mom was going to heaven...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mom always looked so happy when she was listening to her music box.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She'd smile sometimes to make sure I didn't get too worried about her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But whenever she listened to that song on the music box, she seemed genuinely happy.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But it will be able to. Someday, I'll compose a song that can save someone.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Just like dad was able to do with mom, I will find a way...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(A light in the sky...?
But it looks too big for a star...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(They're multiplying...!
One by one, all over the place...!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: It's something your father made when we went on a trip together for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. He said that what we saw was so beautiful, he wanted me to be able to remember it whenever I liked.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
This is a picture of what we saw.
Isn't it wonderful?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow...! It's so pretty!
All those twinkling stars!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: These are actually all lanterns. Everybody writes down their wishes and uses these to send them into the heavens.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Your father and I even wrote down our wishes and sent them up on some lanterns as well.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Your wishes went up and up and up?
That sounds so cool! I wanna try too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: We can all go send our wishes on these lanterns together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Right, this is what mom saw... This scene...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So many lanterns floating up into the sky...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I didn't expect to find you here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If you're here, Miku, that means this is SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In SEKAI, fragments of feelings that are yet to manifest as a SEKAI of their own can cement themselves and take on a form of their own...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That is why you were able to access this place as you did...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Fragments of feelings...
So that means this is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope they can keep going up and up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All the way up into the heavens...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's already this late...
I need to visit mom's grave...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I have to take mom's music box...
Oh, and go there first too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
He's asleep again today.
I haven't had any luck lately.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Dad...
I'm going to go see mom, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've made sure to bring her music box and her favorite flowers to her grave.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I may not be able to now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But someday, I will compose a song that can save someone. I'll compose a song that can save dad...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, a piano won't work here...
It needs something stronger...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I can test out a few more sounds. Once this part's done...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you as always, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just doing my job. Please, while everything's still warm.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay... Oh, is that a branch from a cherry tree in that bottle?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it is. I came across it by a park on my way over here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Some children were playing catch and they accidentally broke this branch off.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It even has buds that look like they're ready to bloom...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Exactly. That's why it seemed like such a shame to just leave it be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I knew that Ms. Mochizuki's an incredibly kind person, but I didn't realize that even extended to animals and plants.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But this branch is so thin. Do you think it'll still bloom like this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, about that. I did some research and read that if you put it in water with some fertilizer mixed in, it'll still have a chance to bloom.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My mother and I do some gardening at home, so we have plenty of fertilizer. I went back to get some to try this method out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Housework, cooking and gardening?
You must be superwoman.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we just grow some herbs in small planters, so it's really nothing special.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And please excuse me. I've been talking your ear off, haven't I...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I'm not much of a talker, and I like hearing about what you do, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When I was little, mom, dad and I went to see them together. I only remember that they were really beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I wish we could see them again...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um, Ms. Mochizuki?
If this branch does end up blooming, would you mind showing me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, of course!
I'll do my best to make sure it does!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, I brought it over as promised!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but one of the buds just wouldn't open up. Luckily, all the other ones turned into cherry blossoms just fine!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I never knew that they could still bloom like this even after what happened to it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki, would it be okay if I borrowed this for a little while? There's someone I'd like to show this to...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You can have it, Ms. Yoisaki. My original plan was to place it somewhere in your room once it managed to bloom.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course. I even brought you some extra fertilizer water to make sure it stays healthy for as long as possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As long as you keep giving it that, you should be able to enjoy it for a good while longer.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because you had such a gentle look in your eyes just now when you saw this. It felt like it meant much more to you then it did to me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I apologize if I'm assuming too much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I promise to take good care of it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Dad, I brought you a change of clothes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (He's sleeping again. To be fair, it is nice and warm out today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's also something I want to show you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Here, some cherry blossoms.
A very good friend of mine gave them to me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hope you still remember...
That time we went to see them with mom...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe someday, we can go again together...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All that's left is to see what everybody thinks, make adjustments based on that and our next song should be ready...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll have to start thinking about the next song too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That song I heard on the way back from the hospital was so nice...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The guitarist did a good job too. Some parts sounded a little unrefined, but it felt both powerful and kind at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I doubt I could create the same sound even if I had the music in front of me...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Only the person who was playing that can probably create the atmosphere I felt...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Powerful but kind, and a hint of doubt...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This should turn into a good melody.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I've just been working on my own part, but what's the plan for today?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That should be fine for now. But can I ask you to give something a listen before you do?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh! Did you think of something for the song after the next one?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I did. It's far from done, but I'd like to hear what you all think.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sure, why not? Just give me a second.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You made this the same way you always do, K...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Huh? Yes, I did but... Was something off about it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, nothing like that. The melody feels like something you'd come up with but...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Having such a bright and happy opening seems rare coming from you, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <At the same time, there seemed to be some deeper meaning behind this melody...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, that! I can't put my finger on it, but didn't it feel like it was trying to encourage you or something?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Actually, it's based off something I heard a street performer play the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The sound felt like something only they could produce and I kind of liked it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I wanted to capture that feeling somehow and create a melody that reflected my impression of that performance.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But if it deviates too far from what we usually make as N25, I'll scrap it...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, I think it'll be fine. It might actually even end up being a nice little surprise.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'd like to hear it once all the way through.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay, I understand.
Let's make this one together...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright! Now you gotta give us the full version of this song!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Yoisaki.
Shall I start cooking and cleaning as always?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Mochizuki. I need to thank you for the cherry blossoms from the other day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They've all wilted and the branch has sort of dried out...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I was able to show it to the person I was hoping to most.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really?
I'm glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We managed to get our new song up in time, but I still don't have anything for our next song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Even after spending so much time thinking about it, nothing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And about our next song. You know how we talked about some rough themes last time?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I came up with a few sketches based on those. Mind taking a look?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. Looks like someone's getting excited! Plus, you'll get a better picture after you hear more of the next song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Sorry, about that...
I'm still working through a few ideas, so I'd like a little more time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But there's still a bunch of time until our deadline, so you don't need to rush.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, that won't work. This won't reach anyone. I need to dig deeper, it needs to be stronger...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Sigh*... Still nothing.
I was hoping to have a demo track done today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Logic trees, brainstorming, more efficient ways of coming up with ideas...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But this won't help me now...
How about...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Not this... This either...!
Next is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm starting to get hungry...
Wait, I just had dinner...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Did my clock break?
No, wait, it's a PC clock.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I spent half a day making no progress...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, right. It's Ms. Mochizuki's day to come over!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (My sheet music's all over the floor now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I believe that wraps up cleaning for today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd like to apologize for making you do so much more than usual...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's perfectly alright. Just leave all the cleaning to me!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I noticed this while I was sweeping up, but have you been cleaning the filters on your air purifiers, Ms. Yoisaki...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? No, I don't think I have since we bought them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then how about I do that for you next week?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure having some nice, clean air to breathe will help you work more efficiently.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, excuse me. It's just that, well, it looked like you were stuck or having trouble coming up with something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to clean the filters on your air conditioners as well, but I suppose that should be left to the professionals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Air purifiers lose some of their effectiveness if they're used with an air conditioner that hasn't been cleaned in a while. I recommend cleaning each from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see... Thank you, I will.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for coming today, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you too. I'll see you again next week.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Cleaning the air conditioner... I've never even thought about doing that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I need to work on my song first...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I'm still hitting a wall. I can't think of a good melody...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, what if I went to SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should tell everyone that's where I'll be...)
A few days after the trip

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The idea of going on a trip like that surprised me at first, but we got to see that beautiful cherry blossom tree in the end and it even helped me come up with a good melody...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
I'm getting thirsty. I should get something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Was that from my headphones...?
I... I definitely heard something...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Huh?! It's coming from the ceiling too...!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Th-This sound...! It wasn't just my imagination!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (D-Did I just see...? Red eyes...? Over in the corner...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hm...? The red lights that I saw in the corner are gone now too. Is my mind playing tricks on me...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Nevermind, I need to check these messages first...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Looks like it. I guess I can just send her what I need her to see for now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <There's no hurry. You don't need to reply to us right now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, it's not about that. Well, maybe it is but...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <K, what's wrong...? It sounded like your voice was trembling...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I... I've been hearing these strange noises coming from parts of my room...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I saw a red light that looked like a pair of eyes over in the corner too, I think...!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Maybe a ghost followed her home during the ride back...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <A ghost?! Following someone home?! No way! There's no way that's possible!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I saw one in the abandoned school. That girl.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Am I the only one that can hear this...?!
So it's really a gh-gh-gh...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We probably can't hear it because it's too quiet.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What if you moved your mic closer to it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<And salt, K! Salt!
Something to purify it!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No! I heard it too this time!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A-A-And those red lights are back too...! They're flashing...!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, that sounds like your air purifier...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Your air purifier. I went out to buy one with you the other day. It's lights turning red and flashing like that might mean there's something wrong with it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You're right...
It got buried under the boxes for my noodles...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And Ms. Mochizuki even said that I should clean its filter...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I never knew there was this side to you, K...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Don't mind her, K! If Mizuki hadn't taken us to see those creepy places, none of this would've happened!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Heya? Do you know what we've been through?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I don't have time for that. I have to keep composing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It needs to resonate more with Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It needs to revolve around what she's feeling and have a melody that expresses that with each note...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I forgot that I skipped lunch because it felt like too much of a bother. I guess I should at least put a pot on...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Voice
rows.Line: Just wait three minutes and... Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If I change the tone a little here for the melody, it might help stir up some emotions.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki, hello.
It's me, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I'll be right there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. Let's see... So I'll be cleaning and making some food... Oh, did I catch you in the middle of a meal?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This cup of noodles on the table. I was just wondering if...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... That was supposed to be my dinner...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I completely forgot about it while I was working...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You've been working since last night until now?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. It's nothing unusual for me so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What about water?! Have you at least been staying hydrated?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I haven't felt thirsty so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means you haven't eaten or had anything to drink for half a day...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: P-Please, sit down and relax for now! I'll be borrowing your kitchen!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you for making this.
Oh, it's good...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't know that you could turn soggy noodles into a real dish like this. You never cease to amaze me, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You even made me this drink so that I stay hydrated.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's just a mixture of sugar, salt and some lemon juice. I might've been able to give it a smoother taste if I had a little more time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm glad I caught this in time before you really did become too dehydrated.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
But I'm used to it, so it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but even so... I feel like if you don't eat and sleep before you get to work, your body might end up giving out eventually, no?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I know. I start losing focus and see a noticeable drop in quality after doing an all-nighter, so I am trying to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I see that you brought some flowers again today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, these. They're common garden peonies, but a childhood friend of mine taught me how they can look pretty even when they're in individual vases because of the volume of their petals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, there's actually three of them, but one knows quite a lot about flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't know that. They must like flowers a lot then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But another one of these friends is prone to getting sick and was even hospitalized for a while. My other friend visited her every day and always brought her flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Every day...
She wanted her friend to get better as soon as possible, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That reminds me, mom really loved flowers too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki, your friend that was in the hospital, how is she now...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
She's doing just fine!
I'm actually a little worried because she's been so active and energetic.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. That's nice to hear...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm fairly certain that there was an extra cleaning option that I could select, so I'd like to officially add that on.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?! But I've just been bringing these here on my own...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that may be, but I've been enjoying them too. I'd like to set things straight in that regard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll talk to my friend and ask what flowers I should bring next time!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't expect Mafuyu to smile the way she did.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I may not have been able to save her this time but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have Mizuki to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I never thought that I could make someone feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for being so patient.
Here you are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
This smells nice. Are these lychees...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I thought that a fruit-flavored tea would help you relax and refresh you a little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It is. The aroma and flavor both have this calming effect.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I originally planned on having her cook and clean just once a week...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But now, it's like having tea with her is a normal part of my routine.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot...
I brought some more flowers today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. These have a fairly unique shape to them. See?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. That's really interesting. They look like upside-down grapes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they're even called grape hyacinths. Each of these bulbs are actually its flowers.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In European cultures, blue flowers like these tend to be associated with negative symbols, such as despair or loss...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But some also say that beyond that despair or loss is a bright future because there's nowhere else to go but up from there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Also, there's one more thing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They symbolize a connection with others.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, you mentioned the other day that there's someone that's been concerning you. That you'd like to know what they're feeling.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't believe you put so much thought into this just for me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know what to say. I didn't mean to make you do all this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I did this because I wanted to.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All I did was ask an old friend for some advice, so it was no trouble for me, really.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, the one who knows a lot about flowers...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. When I asked her about the kind of symbolism I was looking for, she immediately started telling me about these flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Would you mind thanking her for me when you can? I really like what she's chosen for us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, of course. I'll make sure to tell her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, please feel free to ask me to do more. I'd like to help in any way I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I appreciate the offer but you're already doing plenty for me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (At first, I started using a homemaker service because grandma asked me to...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm glad that you ended up being the person they chose for me, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad that I was chosen to look after your house too, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, this should work for the first verse...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That just leaves the interlude before the chorus... I think I left my notes for that somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There goes my pile of sheet music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I started putting them on the floor after running out of space on my desk.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They can stay on my bed for now.
That should give me some extra leg room...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Now, those notes...
Oh, here they are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And it's 25:00.
I guess this can wait until after I finish talking with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay, good... Oh, Yuki, how do you feel now?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Better. My fever's gone and I've gotten my strength back.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I still can't believe you got that sick. I mean, get up at a normal time, eat right and seem to live a pretty healthy lifestyle overall.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I just can't figure out why, you know...? Did you go to bed one night without drying your hair or something?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<She isn't you, Enanan.
I really can't see Yuki doing something like that...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What's that supposed to mean? I make sure to dry my hair every night. If I don't, it becomes catastrophic the next day.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Well, yeah. When I'm really tired and stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Are you saying that your bedhead is that bad?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, it kind of is...
Has that ever happened to you before, K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Not as far as I can remember.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm just wondering if you actually dry your hair after baths and stuff, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I make sure to dry it enough to prevent it from dripping water everywhere...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But you just let nature take its course after that?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I don't really like using a blow dryer.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, that would be a pain considering how long your hair is... How about you, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I make sure to dry my hair.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, that's not what caused all this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Maybe it was just stress from being too busy?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Usually, you log off before the rest of us, but lately, you've been staying later than me and Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's right. You've been up working late these past few days.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And you have club and stuff during the day at school, right? Plus, cram school on weekends.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I usually take a nap before logging into Nightcord and sleep after that... So, five hours a night...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's about how long I sleep too...
Oh, but I do fall back asleep a lot, so I guess I end up getting like seven hours in...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, Yuki, your schedule's completely packed, so is five hours a night really enough?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I've never thought about that or really ever cared...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, we know how much energy it takes to do what we do, so it's okay to take breaks from time to time. We don't want the same thing happening again.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That doesn't mean much coming from you, K...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. So how about it, K? How much sleep do you usually get?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sometimes I'll try to get myself to sleep, but I usually just fall asleep at my desk...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, you're not exactly the best person to ask in this situation.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Please, K, get some real sleep in, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was going to start leaving sheet music on my bed...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I guess I should clear it off and use it for its intended purpose.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? A chat notification...?
From Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For now, I should just get back to work and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, wait...
She isn't supposed to be here until the day after tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Nothing I ordered online is scheduled to arrive today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is a thank you for the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? Oh, instant noodles and apples...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you.
You came all this way to bring me these?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I may've left my student ID in your room, Kanade. Would you mind if I tried looking for it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, of course...
It's a bit messy right now but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't notice the other day, but you keep so many things in here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I do. I hope we find your ID...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I don't think so. I usually only ever look at sheet music, so nothing like that has caught my eye.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, your room really is a mess...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I'm surprised that you remembered where I live. You really looked awful when I brought you over that time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't remember what happened between the park and here, but my mind was much clearer when I headed home...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness we found it so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. You're the guest here. I should offer to pour you some tea...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... How does Ms. Mochizuki usually prepare her tea?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Start by putting a kettle on...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, I think she warms up the cups with hot water... That means I have to boil some water first and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, why don't you put those down for now? I'd hate to see you drop those cups.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She keeps staring at me... Is something bothering her?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Next, I need to put some tea leaves in the pot... Three scoops, I think?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You should bring that teapot closer to yourself. If you don't, you'll spill the tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, okay.
One... Two... And three.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, the water's boiling.
Now I need to warm up the cups...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You don't have to go that far.
This tea also tastes better when it's steeped in very hot water.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Then I should pour it in now. Where'd my teapot go...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade. You don't need to hold the kettle in one hand and the teapot in the other. You'll burn yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I don't think I've ever seen Ms. Mochizuki do that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you pour too much, it'll spill out...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? R-Right.
It's just the two of us, so I guess I don't need to make that much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Here you are, Mafuyu.
It's very hot, so please be careful...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?! M-Mafuyu, I just said that it's still really hot...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Won't you burn your tongue...?
You should wait until it's cooled down a little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This tea's flavored too.
It's supposed to smell and taste like apples...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess you still can't tell yet...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I hope someday that Mafuyu gets to enjoy these things the way the rest of us do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, the Fan Festival was so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You were probably the most excited person there, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, it was kinda hard to believe how good everyone was!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the amateur division was just one surprise after another! Not only that, all these friends of friends ended up performing too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Were you ever not surprised today...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. But I think I understand what Mizuki's trying to say.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That one girl's performance almost sounded professional. When she sang that song from that one musical, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! She stayed in character the entire time too...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, seriously, I had a hard time believing what I was seeing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't realize that the song she sang was a Miku song either until today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's gotta be in a theatre company or troupe, right? She seemed completely used to performing on stage.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Amateur” officially, but basically pro quality, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly. Also, remember that really cute girl who sang that super cool song?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The second she started singing, she kinda just had the audience completely stunned...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I remember. Her ability alone seemed to turn the entire venue on its head.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can only remember what she sounded like, but she sounded like a seasoned veteran too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow! I'm not really an expert when it comes to music, but that's pretty big coming from you, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Was there anyone you liked, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me? Well, the people you just mentioned, Hanasato and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I sort of remember one performer who didn't sound too used to performing on stage, but knew how to show what they were feeling.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? Hehe. That must mean you really enjoyed yourself today♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Minori really shined today too.
She seemed so pure and delicate, but really powerful at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. It's hard not to root for her, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, what if we made a song like that next?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? It wouldn't sound anything like our other songs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you never know! It could help save someone somewhere out there!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That may be up to you, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which song or performance left the biggest impression on you today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For now, I'll keep that genre in the back of my mind.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay.
I guess it is still your goal to compose a song that can save Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm sure there are some people out there who can be saved by happy and upbeat music like that.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Even I felt a little excited after that performance...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'll need to make some adjustments to that song when I get home.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should be able to improve on it quite a bit after today.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I even added in some of Yuki's lyrics as a test.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, you mean the ones she wrote while she was out with the cold?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's not like I was writing them while curled up in bed.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, K, show us what you got!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay, but I'd like Miku and the others to hear this too, so mind if we meet in SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What brings you all here today...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We were hoping that you'd listen to the song we're currently working on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The song that made Mafuyu smile?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. It even includes some of Mafuyu's lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see... In that case, let me go find MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While we wait, wanna talk some more about the Fan Festival?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! It's like a VIRTUAL SINGER appreciation event! All these performers come together to sing VIRTUAL SINGER songs♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way. We just went to watch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, you don't get it!
Seeing everybody perform was super fun too♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially since our idol friend was in it. I even sort of ended up becoming her fan.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not really... I didn't feel anything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hardly ever listen to idol songs, but I thought the way she sang and danced during her performance really made her shine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, then, why don't you compose a song like that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I doubt that I could.
I'd have too much trouble coming up with that kind of melody.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. If I do learn how to someday, I may be able to give our song a bit more variety...
Hmm... Is there really any point in forcing yourselves to make music that you're not used to dealing with?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, Mafuyu didn't feel anything from any of those performances, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But that's just a small glimpse into that particular genre. The answer could still be hidden somewhere within it, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, so what you're saying is that they should explore these genres more and see if there are any songs that can draw a response out of Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um...
Thank you for joining us, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Don't mind me...
Start whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great! The way it started made me think it's better than it was before!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I like this song a lot too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know that the lyrics are still a work in progress, but they seem to fit in really well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. Mafuyu makes it clear how she feels.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She does. This part felt so warm too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can't you just say that you liked it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, Mafuyu, did you manage to figure anything out...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: As long as I have this song, I won't forget what I felt.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's do everything we can to make this our best song ever! This video's gonna be so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just so you know, I try to draw the best illustrations I can for each video.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you mind showing that to me when it's finished?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Of course. I promise to make it into a good song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to it too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This may only be a small step forward...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But a very important one for Mafuyu, as well as me...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to make this song a good one.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. I can't wait to see what people say about it, but I should probably hit the hay now... *Yawn*...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Great work, everyone.
This took a lot out of us, so we should all get some well-deserved rest.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
It's finally done and uploaded.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to describe it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I liked it, I think...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope that a lot of people listen to it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For now, I should go to bed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to get ready and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I left Nightcord open.
Oh, good... I disconnected before going to bed.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But Ena and Mizuki wrote me something...

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]'s Log
rows.Line: <You awake? Did you see the view count?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]'s Log
rows.Line: <Yeah, I saw! Isn't it awesome?! It's like double what we usually get!>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]'s Log
rows.Line: <Everyone's saying that the video goes really well with the music, so this one might end up becoming our best one yet, you know?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]'s Log
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
I hope K and Yuki get to enjoy this too!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I should take a look.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Oh wow...
So many views and comments...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<It made me cry a little...>
<It feels so warm and comfy, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I've had a lot on my mind lately, but I feel way better after hearing this song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I guess this means it's managed to reach all these people, like the way it reached Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The nurse said that he had some tests done on him this morning, so he must be tired.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I was sort of hoping to talk to him...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Dad, I brought you a song that my friends and I made.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know you're not supposed to play anything loudly but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That time you, Mom and I had a picnic in the park...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd forgotten where we actually went, but someone in my group helped me find it again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks to them, I was able to remember that wonderful time we had together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I even realized how I want to make Mafuyu smile through my music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And so, I composed this song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thanks for listening to it, Dad.
I should get going now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Dad, did you smile just now...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I could've sworn that he just smiled...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm going to keep composing, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm going to compose a song that can make someone... No, a song that can make everyone feel happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
