rows.Line: (The way the key change started off didn't sound right at first, but seems much better now.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (After that, I just need to adjust the interlude a little, and the rough draft should be complete.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, it's half past midnight.
I would've worked past 25:00 if I just kept going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was planning on taking a short break, but I should probably log into Nightcord before I forget...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We are and were all working, but Enanan and Amia were going off on a tangent just now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We were just chatting! What's wrong with that?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah♪ It's important to have a quick breather before things get rolling at 25:00!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, we were just talking about how surprised we were when we ran into Li'l Bro and his friends.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, I didn't really get to talk to them either. All I did was tell them my name.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I remember them mentioning something about performing as a group at live house events.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. They sing street music and are apparently pretty famous around here now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, Yuki, you two probably still don't know much about them, so I'll tell you all about what they're all like!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! Okay, here it goes! They're “powerful”, “cute”, “pure” and “hard-working”!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hold on. Who's who in this case?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Well, my guess is that “powerful” is referring to Shiraishi.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That means... “Cute” and “pure” has to be that really quiet girl, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Nope! You're right about “cute” being Kohane, but “pure” is Toya♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup. I mean, she's sort of turned him into her personal servant...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What? I think “arrogant” is a better word for him.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I didn't realize that you already knew all of them, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, we all go to the same school and one's even my classmate♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, except Kohane. She goes to Miya Girls. Wait, Yuki, have you two ever met before...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Outside of club activities and committee business, I don't have many chances to talk to first years.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't quite remember their faces, so I'm having a bit of a hard time understanding their personalities...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It might help to hear them sing...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, you want to hear them sing?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But Li'l Bro and Toya sang during the Summer Festival. They headlined the amateur division, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I think so...
But which performance were they...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Ena's brother led during the beginning and had his own solo during the second half of their song, but his friend's pitch was much better.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That means you probably remember Kohane too! Just think about the Fan Festival...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You know? The one who we thought wouldn't sing the way she did? That's Kohane.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right! I think she was wearing the same cap as that time too!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't remember what she was wearing, but I remember the way she sang.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She seemed used to performing in front of a crowd, which must have to do with singing with Ena's brother and his friends.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That just leaves An.
All I have to say about her is that she's an unbelievable singer!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. She's even given me some pointers on how to be a good singer♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wow, you two must be pretty good friends.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, yeah. Unlike a certain someone, I have plenty of friends.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Are you saying that I don't have any friends?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Everyone seemed to have a tough time with our last song, but I'm glad they're feeling much better now.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah♪ It was nice to chat like this, but I'm all good to go!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'll send you a draft of my illustration in a little bit, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That ended up being a nice break.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should be able to maintain this pace and finish that draft now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I can't help but feel surprised. I knew that you composed your own music, Ms. Yoisaki, but it's really hard not to be impressed by what you do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And those lyrics...!
They really struck a chord with me.
Did you write those too, Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's been so long since I last discussed what we do with people outside of our group.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... All this talk is making me thirsty.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. Oh, also, did we all ask for free refills at the juice bar?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. I'll head over and... Wah!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I think I just sat on my own hair.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I know the feeling.
Like having your hair yanked while trying to turn your head.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've done that before too. My hair isn't as long as yours, Ichika, Ms. Yoisaki, but it happens from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I've experienced that as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I dropped something this one time and ended up sweeping the floor with my hair while trying to pick it up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's the worst!
Oh, or when your hairdo falls apart, covers your eyes and aren't able to see anything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, long hair seems like more trouble than it's worth whenever that happens.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Yoisaki, I heard that you wear sweats most of the time. Have you ever had your hair get caught in a zipper or anything...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that happens quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I knew it!
It happens to me all the time whenever I try putting on my hoodie.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It may just be the cost of having long hair.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Maybe.
I do sometimes wonder if I should try a shorter hairstyle...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But not many people notice when I do cut my hair since it's already so long.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, it may be that only your closest friends are really able to see the difference.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sometimes it sounds so nice to have shorter hair. Life just seems so much easier...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You'd be saving quite a bit of time and money in terms of washing it. Also, less drying time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, like during summer. It's awful when you end up sweating while your hair's still trying to dry just after washing it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you have the longest hair out of all of us, Yoisaki. It must take quite a while for your hair to dry completely, no?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I usually just try to wring it out as best I can and let it dry on its own after that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That might work during the summer, but you could catch a cold if you do that in winter, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know. I'm usually careful about that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: To be honest, drying my hair isn't that much of a problem. Windy days are actually the worst for me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, because of your hair getting blown in your face?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, there's that. But also because of how I can't move forward when my hair gets blown back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Kanade, I have to think you're the only person around who gets overwhelmed by the wind like that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: R-Really? I thought everyone with long hair had this problem...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: At night, you notice that your curtains are open a tiny bit and go to close them, but this long-haired girl suddenly appears...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes! You're staggered for a moment, but you realize that it's just your reflection!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you...!
I'm glad you understand.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You're not too fond of ghosts or anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait, is that true?
I never would've thought.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. She even mentioned this one time when she started hearing a strange noise while in her room.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: See? They want to know more.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I get that, but it's so embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay, fine.
We'll keep it our little secret.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you.
Sorry about this, you two.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's been fun talking about our hair stories like this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. You have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's been so long since I last had a conversation like this with people outside of our group too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's a little early, but I think I'll log in now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We were wondering how things went for you and Yuki today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You met the girl who lent you that CD, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, we got to talk over a nice meal.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's nice. Yuki, you said this girl goes to the same school as you and is also a class representative too?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, she was there with someone else I know too. They've apparently been friends since childhood and are in a band together now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Does that mean you got to talk a lot about music with them?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We did. They showed quite a bit of interest in how we make our songs and videos.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. We also talked about Miku songs and our hair.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hehe. All four of us just happened to have long or medium-length hair...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So we talked a little about what we've experienced as a result of having this kind of hair.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<What?! That sounds like fun!
Can you give us an example?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Let's see... Getting your hair stuck in a seat's backing or sitting on it by accident immediately comes to mind...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, and your head gets yanked really hard!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And how your hair might end up brushing the floor while trying to pick something up.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Or how it can get stuck on a zipper when you're wearing sweats...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I usually have my hair all tied up, but that can definitely happen after I take a bath or something since I have to let my hair down...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We also discussed how it takes so much time to dry long hair and whether or not we could make our lives easier by getting it trimmed.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But you probably couldn't be bothered to cut your hair, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I get what you mean...
But there must be some perks to having long hair, right? Like not having to worry about bedhead.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. When you have hair as short as mine, you end up sleeping on the ends. That causes them to split and get all bent out of shape by the time you wake up.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But if you have long hair, you can just tie it up, move it off to the side and not worry about getting bedhead.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see. I've never thought about it that way.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Do you even sleep in a bed, K?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And even if your hair does get a little messy, you can hide it by cleverly tying it up.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's been a while now since we first formed this group, but we haven't actually had many conversations together like this.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mizuki and Ena are usually always talking about something, but Mafuyu didn't use to say much during conversations like the one we had just now.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I've had a chance to get to know everyone better by going to SEKAI, meeting Miku and learning more about Mafuyu's situation...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So I feel like we're working much better together now when making videos.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (To be fair, I knew Mafuyu and the others already before all this happened, but if someone were to ask me about anybody else...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I met Ms. Mochizuki through that housekeeping service a little while back...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I initially tried to keep some distance between us as a sort of professional courtesy.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Still, I don't think I've spoken like that with anyone since junior high school...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Back then, it felt so normal for me and my friends to chat while having lunch together...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm probably not all that different from Mafuyu. I've lost and forgotten about so many things.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (However, I'm glad that I've been able to realize that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... My stomach won't stop grumbling. I was so close to figuring out what I want to do for our next song too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot... Ms. Mochizuki made me some extra food that I just need to heat up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can keep working while I eat that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She cooks, cleans, brews tea and brings flowers for me... It almost feels like I'm being waited on hand and foot...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She's even been saying that it's all a part of her job, and she's technically right...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I want to show her my appreciation somehow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Yoisaki!
Your housekeeper's here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Mochizuki.
Thank you for coming again today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's my pleasure! I'll start by cleaning as usual. Is there anything you'd like to eat today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now that you mention it... That stew you made the other day was really good, so I'd like to have that again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm glad you liked it so much!
That means I'll have to find a way to make it taste even better this time!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. Oh, I also have another request...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, how can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... If you don't mind, could you brew the tea a little later than usual?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, that must be the stew. It smells so nice...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (As excited as I am about her stew, I'm worried about what comes after that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should probably review what I need to do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Oh, okay. I'll be right there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're very welcome. Again, I'm glad you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You genuinely seem to enjoy having it each time, which makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: W-Was I smiling too much or something...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've been getting a little better at understanding how you feel based on your body language.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see.
I didn't realize I was such an open book.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Also, you mentioned that you wanted to put off tea until a little later...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, about that...
I'd like to brew it myself today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What? Are you sure, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I want to give back to you somehow since you're always here to make me this delicious food.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But this is about the only thing I could come up with regards to what I can actually do for you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So please, let me brew some tea for you today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Understood. In that case, I'd love some.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll get everything ready now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
First... Get the kettle boiling...
While that goes, get the tea leaves and pot ready...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I only have the tea you brought me, Ms. Mochizuki, but what kind of tea would you like...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Next... Oh, right, I need to warm up the cups, but I'm still waiting for the kettle to boil... I know. I can just add some extra water right now and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Should I tell her that it's okay to use the water from the kettle before it boils...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now, the tea leaves... One scoop... Two... Three...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(H-Her scoops are too big...!
B-But this is Earl Grey... It should taste just right by adding in some milk...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, the kettle's boiling.
I need to warm up the cups...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I was caught a little off guard when some boiled over.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All that's left is to pour it into the pot and wait for it to steep.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now to serve them with the cups and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? This looks darker compared to when you make this, Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait... I can balance that out with a little more water...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
M-Ms. Yoisaki!
Why don't we have some milk tea this time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Earl Grey and milk go very well together, so I recommend using that instead of hot water.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see.
Thank you. I'll do just that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... Here you are, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that smells nice.
Without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... It's been a while since I last had milk tea, but it's sweet in a very gentle way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. There's nothing wrong with adding sugar, but it's much more subtle when prepared this way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, you're much better at this than I am. Your tea always tastes and smells so much nicer, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really appreciate your kind words, but this is actually very good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After all, Ms. Yoisaki, this is your way of thanking me, no?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can taste your kindness and warmth with each drop.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, so thank you very much for this wonderful gift.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for always making such incredible food for me. I'm really looking forward to having more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course! I'll be looking forward to that as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Another job well done♪
Alright, let's start ordering some food!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, someone's gotta do it or nothing's gonna get done, am I right? Anyway, Kanade, Mafuyu, here's the menu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I already know what I'm getting.
I've been craving wonton noodles all day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, because they're good and easy to eat. What are you going to get, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think I'll look for something light...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sure, look as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, all our drinks are here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here's to another job well done!
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We're getting a lot of comments this time too. Plus, it already has a ton of views.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, a couple of people really liked the effect I used for the chorus! Good eye, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but credit where credit's due, the clarity I achieved with my illustration is what made your effects come to life.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was reminiscing a little about how we started out not knowing each others' names or faces, and comparing that to how meeting in real life like this has become a regular occurrence.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (In hindsight, a lot really has changed...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<It's nice to meet you too, Ms. Yuki...
I'm K...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That day, I met “Yuki” for the first time, and we started making music together...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Back then, we could talk to each other through Nightcord, and we didn't seem to mind not being able to put names to faces.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Be honest, K, Enanan, Amia...
You all want to disappear more than anyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Mafuyu was probably right.
I think we did want to disappear somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And yet, we were able to clearly communicate with one another without knowing each others' names and faces...)

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Here's your parfait with freshly picked strawberries available for a limited time only!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, that's me!
Wow, talk about photogenic...
I bet this'll create a ton of buzz online.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Mafuyu, Mizuki, mind moving those plates for me? They're getting in my shot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Okay, what if I tried a low-angle shot...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
E-Ena, watch your elbow!
You're gonna knock over your glass!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Th-That was close...!
Nice save, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Ena, I'll keep your drink safe over here.
It should give you more space to work with too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You will? Thanks, I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, that looks good!
Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This may be coming way too late...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I hope we get to keep making music together like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! And the last horse crosses the line...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we all definitely feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And I need you to keep composing, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know. I haven't forgotten our promise.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to doing more with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Yoisaki.
Thank you for having me again today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, shall I start cleaning as usual?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, before you do...
Would you mind taking a look at something for me first?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's quite a large box.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My grandma sent over a big care package because, “You deserve to have something delicious for your birthday.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's right. Your birthday's next week. I promise to make a wonderful feast for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let's see... She's sent you...
Some vegetables, rice... And some snacks.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Please, make whatever you like.
I mean, all I'd really be able to do is cook this rice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is there anything you'd like to have for your birthday? You have quite a lot of options based on how many ingredients we have at our disposal.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I can't think of anything...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Everything you make is always delicious, Ms. Mochizuki, so it doesn't have to be anything special.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure? In that case, I'll try coming up with a birthday menu for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... It's come a long way since I first drafted it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That just leaves the adjustments I still need to make for the interludes, which means we may be able to upload it next week.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, I forget how the illustrations and video are coming along...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I know it's still before 25:00, but I think I'll ask Ena and Mizuki to see how they're doing.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Perfect timing! We were just talking about what to do for your birthday, K! Are you free next week?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Awesome! Let's have a party in SEKAI next week♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I appreciate the offer, but I sort of want to focus on finishing this song first...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, how about we throw you a party once it's done? We can even do it instead of having an afterparty like usual!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, great idea!
What do you think, K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay...
We can have a party after we've uploaded this song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks, K!
I promise to have my illustration ready in time for it!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That means I've gotta try my best too!
I'll be on mute until 25:00.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Wait... Sorry, Yuki...
We sort of forgot to ask how you feel about all this.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't mind. It's your birthday, isn't it?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm almost done revising the lyrics, so I'll send them over soon.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should also get back to work.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I don't see any problems...
Let's go with this.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You both cut it pretty close this time...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Right?
We had to cut back on sleep to get everything finished.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I was honestly pretty worried that we wouldn't make it in time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Think you can upload it by your birthday, K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. The song itself is essentially complete, and adjusting the timing for the song and video shouldn't take very long.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Thank goodness! We can finally start getting everything ready for that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup! Party poppers are a must, right? Also, a cake...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They wanted to throw me a party that much...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, you're here too... And everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You two have been here this whole time, no, MEIKO, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. We were told to stay put because they wanted to have the party here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It just seemed easier to do that as opposed to inviting you to come to the actual party.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Enough about us.
Why don't you get started already since the birthday girl's here?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I took the cake out of the box already.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Mafuyu!
Alright, to start things off...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We thought it'd suit you.
Also, a strawberry shortcake seemed appropriate for the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's a number on top of the cake...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's actually a candle♪
You're really supposed to have as many as the person's age...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But poking a bunch of holes into this would've made it pretty hard to eat, so we went with this instead.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't know they made these.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness too. I might've run out of breath trying to blow out so many candles...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu, Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade.
Happy birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Aren't you going to blow out the candle, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, let's start cutting it.
Take whichever piece you like.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, the second one from the right's a little bigger than the rest.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? No way. They look even to me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! Here you are, Kanade!
You get a special piece of chocolate on top that says, “Happy birthday♪”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When's the last time I had cake like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's sweet... But in a really gentle way.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How's the cake, you guys?
This place is supposed to be pretty famous so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We can't help you much there...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin, you have some cream on your cheek. Here, I'll get it for you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's okay. I'll get it myself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was just about to wipe it off...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was reminded of when my mom wiped cream off of my cheek for me when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Which means you had cake that time.
Is there more to your story...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'd like to know as well.
How did you celebrate that time?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Mommy!
Can you make me another “special plate” for my birthday?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: I want Salisbury steak, spaghetti, gratin, fried shrimp and pudding!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My mom used to make me this “special plate” each year for my birthday...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. It included all my favorite things and I used to look forward to it every year...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And yet, I'd forgotten about it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I used to look forward to her “special plate” almost as much as presents and cake.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But where was that all this time...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It might be because they're here to celebrate with me.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Before I get started, Ms. Yoisaki, I brought something that Ichika asked me to hand you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh wow. These flowers are beautiful...
But this one looks wrapped...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Remember how you let her buy that CD by that one artist? She said she came across one of their CDs when they were just starting out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait, that's incredible...
I've tried looking myself, but never had any luck.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. She apparently looked all over online and asked around on some forums.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I don't know what to say...!
Thank you for bringing this to me, Ms. Mochizuki. Please tell Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, wait.
I should thank her by sending a message myself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
Can I make a request?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was reminded of what my mom used to make for my birthday each year.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know it's the day after, but I was wondering if you could make some of those things for me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm not sure I'll be able to match your mother, but I promise to try my best!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, what did she use to make?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Yoisaki.
I was hoping to hand your birthday present to you in person, but it was good to hear that you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If possible, I'd like it if we could meet again to eat somewhere and talk more about music. I also really want to chat with you more about Miku songs and the music you make.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ms. Yoisaki.
Thank you for requesting the “special plate” that your mother used to make for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please feel free to also ask for some desserts to go along with your meal.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks for letting us throw you a birthday party, Kanade! I know they're not really your thing, but I'm glad you had so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, also! I got a good pic of all of us, so I'll send it to you through Nightcord later♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade!
I wasn't expecting to be able to get everyone to gather for your party, but I'm really glad we did!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We can make this a little tradition if you like. Oh, we could even try a chocolate cake next time. I know this really great bakery, so I'm sure you'll like it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure what to call this feeling, but whenever I'm with you... It's like my heart becomes restless...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
And I'll be waiting...
For when you'll fulfill your promise to me, someday.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for celebrating my birthday with me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was able to remember some of the things my family used to do to celebrate because of this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I probably wouldn't have been able to recall any of that on my own, so I'll need to thank everyone later...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't ever want to forget these memories again...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Not ever...
I want to cherish these precious memories.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So again, thank you for today.
I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We talked before she went off to that art class, but she seemed really unsure about going. That kinda made me worried...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm not sure if it's okay for me to say this right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Can you tell us more about what you two talked about, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She doesn't think she's good enough...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. She's convinced that you and Mafuyu keep finding new ways to express yourselves while she hasn't.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And she's worried that her illustrations won't be able to do your songs justice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had a feeling that she was going through something of a slump, but I didn't realize it was this serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This art class she's attending...
She quit once already, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Which is making it that much harder for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You need a lot of guts to ask someone to teach you again after leaving them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To make things worse, this teacher's apparently not exactly a ray of sunshine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, can't she just go somewhere else...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's the thing. This teacher's also a really accomplished artist...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So much so that Ena wants to learn from studying art under them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's as if drawing for N25 is what forced her down this terrible path...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not the right way to look at this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At the very least, I doubt she'd ever put herself on the line in such a way...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think so too. Ena's all about whether or not she can produce something that's to her liking.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean.
That's just who she is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Remember when Mafuyu was still making music as OWN here and she said she'd come to SEKAI to give her a piece of her mind?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I totally froze when she jumped in and screamed, “Just knock it off already!”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Mafuyu. You as well, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I understand now that Ena wasn't forced into a corner. She made this choice herself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not fully appreciating her situation only served to belittle her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <In my current state, I feel like I won't be able to draw anything decent for this song or anything that comes after it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That one sentence encapsulates what Ena's going through right now.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for sharing this information with us, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll be sure to apologize to her later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay. If she does get mad, I'll be there to take my punishment too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What do you plan on doing now...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That won't change.
We'll just have to give her some time to finish her illustration.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I know what she's going through now, so I want to tell her that myself...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I want to tell her that we're willing to wait for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll let you guys know if I hear anything more from her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm glad that it's warm out, but I didn't realize that it'd be this bright out...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Outside's the last place I expected to see you.
Were you out visiting your dad?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I was about to buy some flowers before I made my way to the hospital. What about you, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just buying some art supplies for some practice drawings. Some of my stuff's really old now, so it's about time I replaced them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see.
It sounds like you're hard at work.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not really. I'm just getting started...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Especially since I was given an earful during the last day of the workshop.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: First, I do not understand the message you're trying to convey.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I cannot tell what this person's feeling is aside from having no real interest in facing their art. There seems to be no point of focus either.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You appear to have put quite a bit of effort into these shadows to illustrate that it's nighttime, but it has become too dark as a result. Ideas are important, but so is presentation.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow... That's worse than I initially imagined... Your teacher's very... Honest.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. At the same time, he'll tell you what he thinks is wrong and what needs fixing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But he's so direct. He says all this in front of the entire class, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, getting torn down like that used to bother me a lot...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But I'm done running.
I'm gonna keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I just have to learn to see my flaws as areas of improvement.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. You've come to accept your own flaws.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not only that, you're willing to listen to what others say.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not everyone has an easy time doing that, especially when it involves the ugly truth.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think that makes you an incredible person, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But don't forget that you're a big part of why I was able to accept my flaws and reach this conclusion.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know that I want to keep drawing, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. But I don't just want to draw. I want to produce illustrations that do the songs you and Mafuyu make justice. I want to draw what I envision in my head.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because I really love the music and lyrics you are able to produce...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But no telling Mafuyu this, okay?
She has a big enough head as it is.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There are times when I can't find the right notes or chords for a song's demo.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But Mafuyu's lyrics, Mizuki's storyboards and your illustrations are sometimes able to guide me towards eureka moments.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Like you're telling me which note to write down...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's why I want you to remember that we're there to help if you ever get stuck. We want to help you find the right answer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But don't try too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You need to take good care of yourself too, so make sure to eat right, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry. I think I've kept you long enough, but I'm glad we had this chat.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow! The night show was so good!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it was. The story and effects were very good, so I'm glad we came to see it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But the park's about to close, so I guess we should head out soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Looks like everyone's also getting ready to leave now that the night show's over.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we're all going home now, so worst case scenario, we can just call it a day if we get separated.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! A trip's not over until you get home, right? Let's at least stick together until we get to the station...

rows.Speaker: Tour Guide
rows.Line:
Attention Starling Tour guests!
We will now be heading out, so we ask that you please try to stay with the group!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! Watch out for the tourists!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? Uh oh...!
I can't get out...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If we get separated, Mafuyu's going to be all alone...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, what's the matter? You're clinging to my arm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I was worried that you'd get separated and end up all alone again.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If anything, Kanade, you were the one that was about to get separated.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, wanna wait a bit until there are less people? It seems way too hard to walk or move around right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. That may be for the best...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The station and all the buses are probably gonna be packed too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There. I think that bench can seat all four of us...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, good eye! Let's sit and take a quick breather!

rows.Speaker: Visitor
rows.Line: Riding the roller coaster at night was awesome! It being too dark to really see the track made it just that much more exhilarating!

rows.Speaker: Visitor
rows.Line: Yeah! And the way the big drop sneaks up on you while you get a good look at all the illuminations!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wah...!
There's still a lot of people...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because you found me again, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(That look...
Is it just me, or did she sound a little happy just now?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, if you're okay with that person being me, I'll keep finding you as many times as you need...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alright, let's go. The others are waiting for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even though I took a bath and went straight to bed after getting back from Phoenix Wonderland yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I only planned on taking a quick nap, but I ended up sleeping until noon...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Is it because I lack stamina?
I still feel pretty tired...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No...
I got to have fun yesterday, so I have to make up for that time by working a little harder today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I hope Mafuyu's okay.
And I really hope that her mom didn't scold her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (<Were things okay at home after you got back?>...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, time to get to work.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Okay, I have a few different concepts to work with now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was having so much trouble coming up with anything before too. I guess this means our trip was worth it.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now, I need to hammer out the details and choose which one to...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Is everything okay, Yuki...?
You hardly ever log in this early.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You sent me a message, didn't you...? I thought it'd be better to reply by talking.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<And you logged on to do just that.
Thank you, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Everything went okay...
I made sure to say why I was late for the practice exam before I returned home.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. She was incredibly worried about me and said that I should've let her know sooner even though I was trying to rest.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She was still worried this morning and told me to just get some rest...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was worried that she'd be scolded, so it's good to hear that she wasn't...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, there's something I'd like to tell you...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's going to be difficult for me to work at 25:00 for the foreseeable future...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It is? Do you have to study for another practice exam or something?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She told me to refrain from studying at night for the sake of my own health...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So she asked me to get up to study in the morning. Early to bed and early to rise they say...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And Mafuyu's mom seems to be genuinely concerned about her daughter's health...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Understood. We should be fine, so for now, try to focus on putting your mom's mind at ease.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Okay...
But I still want to keep writing lyrics...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I just won't be able to meet at 25:00 is all... Plus...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You're still going to compose the song that's supposed to save me, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for taking the time to talk with me like this, Mafuyu. And please don't push yourself too hard when writing lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She still wants to write lyrics and is also waiting for me to compose that song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which means I'll just have to keep composing more and more songs.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This whole day was so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When's the last time I moved my body around like that...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I feel tired...
But refreshed at the same time.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It turned out to be a nice workout, Hanasato. Thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, while we're at it! Kanade, Ena, mind if we swap contact info? I wanna send you guys the pics I took today!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Same. You just need my QR code, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you see an icon that says, “Add a friend,” anywhere...? Oh, there! That one!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ena.
Oh, I think it worked...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, I don't usually do these kinds of things very often...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, that's okay!
Anyway, I'll scan them now...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um... Ena...
Can we swap contact information too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, I think we're all set!
We've swapped all our contact info and set up a group chat!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Kanade, look.
There's a “You're welcome!” stamp posted to the group chat we just made.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
This stamp... It looks like an otter.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Correct! It was released just recently!
I really recommend it because it's super cute and great for quick greetings!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I don't use stamps at all, but if they can save me the trouble of having to type everything out... I think I'll get the same ones as you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Then, I'll post the referral link! If you get them through that, you'll get three other stamps for free!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't really have any like these, so I might get them too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Good idea.
Conversations become more fun when others have the same stamps too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm getting sleepy... Is it because I just took a bath...? I am pretty tired, so maybe I should lie down for...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Great workout today!
I put together an album out of the pictures I took, so I hope you get a chance to look through them!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, she did mention that she'd send some over.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks for today, Minori.>
<I'll post some of the pics I took too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Ena replied...
In that case, I'll...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<Minori, Ena, thank you.
I'll take a look at them now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um... <Thank you for today.>
Hmm... I'm so slow at typing on a smartphone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Oh, I know! What if we all met up somewhere to chat?>
<It'd be great to talk about what we're gonna do for our next workout, and I wanna hear more about your band and group!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, she changed the topic.
I should erase what I was just writing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<I was about to say the same thing!>
<I'd love to hear more about all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I wanna hear more about your band.>
<I found this great cafe that just opened up recently, so why don't we go there?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Oh, a cafe that Ena recommends?!>
<I wanna go! I wanna go!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It says she's seen our messages, so she should still be up.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We're probably gonna talk about group stuff after this, so I'll see if she's okay with us meeting up then.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She saved me. I'll need to thank her later...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Hanasato and Hoshino sent stamps...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, that's it. I bought some stamps too. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This conversation's just about ended so I'll try using these “Sorry” and “Thank you” stamps...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Now I see. This is how I can use these stamps.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I still can't really see myself being a part of that conversation...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Still, I've made some new friends, so I should do my best to get in something next time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You've been groaning for a while, K. What's wrong?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Is your song giving you trouble? Did you get stuck again?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I'm sorry... I didn't mean to groan out loud...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I can't say that I'm completely okay... But it's just some muscle soreness, so there's nothing to worry about...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You too, K?
I'm actually still pretty sore too...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, I almost forgot! You guys went out for a walk together, right? If you're feeling sore, then it means you actually put in a good effort.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Actually put in a good effort...?
Why does it sound like there's some hidden meaning behind that...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, we did get in a good workout. There's no way I would've done anything like this just living life as usual.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, we did. Although, those rollerblades gave me a lot of trouble in the beginning.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Rollerblades?
What happened to going out for a walk?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, you guys went to SpoJoy Park with Minori?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And this other girl. She's the one who you let have that CD and later became friends with through Yuki, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, and I'm really glad we got to talk again.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's great! I'm glad for you, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Plus, you seem to have enjoyed exercising, so you might be able to make it a regular thing!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <This isn't just a one-and-done thing, is it...? You know you have to keep going if you actually want to increase your stamina, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I understand, but this soreness...
My muscles ache so much that it's hard to focus on work...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Which is why I decided I'm going to continue working out occasionally. I even did some research on less intense ways to stay active day to day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, did you look up some strength training videos or something?>

rows.Speaker: Homepage
rows.Line: <“Electric Fitness Platform”!! Over 3 million sold nationwide!!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<It sounds incredible.
Look, just standing on it ten minutes every day is supposed to be a good workout.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <K, don't tell me you bought one already.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Thank goodness! Actually using it's one thing, but you might want to take a look at the reviews first.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, some do their job, but there's usually a ton of cheap imitations floating around out there.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, you're right.
There's a message on this one's website warning people to “beware of imitation products”.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Wait, really?
Then, I guess this one seems okay...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No, hold on.
This one really doesn't seem like a good idea.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <See the picture of the person who says they lost 10 kg in just a month?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The person in the picture's actually of someone who makes yoga videos. I bet this “reviewer” cropped out that person's top half and is calling it their own.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hang on. How did you know who that person was, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I also started looking for ways to be active more regularly without having to push myself too hard.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <My point is, K, you probably shouldn't buy anything from this company since they seem shady and all of their products look really iffy.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
I guess I have to start over...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, gadgets are nice, but I feel like going outside to exercise is still the best solution.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I've gotta think your mind and body will appreciate getting some sun as opposed to working out in a dark room with the curtains closed.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And if you're not up to exercising on your own, I can be your workout buddy next time!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's more fun when someone's there with you instead of having to exercise all by yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay, let's try something together next time. We can even try to invite Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Also, where is Yuki?
I know it isn't 25:00 yet, but I feel like she should've logged in by now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I'm sorry. I forgot to relay her message. She sent me a DM saying that she won't be able to make it again today.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, since we're all here, let's get to work.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, this doesn't sound right either...
It needs to be more like a soft whisper...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's not the sound I imagined when I made this demo...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Even after having everyone listen to it in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Kanade! Mafuyu!
You two hardly ever come here at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I found some time to work...
Also, Kanade wanted to hear what I thought about her new demo.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes.
We even sent messages to both of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
We were having so much fun talking that we didn't notice at all...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Mizuki and the others said that they were talking about what happened in the past.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (After Ena and Mizuki joined, more people began listening to our songs as they were turned into music videos.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Just as when I invited Mafuyu, I'm glad that I invited them to work with us.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I need to keep working...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The demo itself seemed to be going in a good direction... So it could be an issue of some chords not being in the right places...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're fine. It's only been like five minutes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What? Whenever I'm even a little late, you always get super mad.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? I'm not gonna feel sad or lonely if someone's late by just five minutes.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, K, it's pretty rare for you to be running late. Were you trying to focus just now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I was working on that demo I had you all listen to the other day, but I'm having trouble getting it to sound the way I originally imagined.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, that song? I thought it was pretty good when you had us listen to it...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, same. I was under the impression that you pretty much had a complete picture in your head for it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, I thought so too...
I had a good idea of what I wanted to do...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But for some reason, what I had in my head isn't quite meshing with the melody I've been getting. Almost like I've been entering the wrong things...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Is there an issue with the chord progression...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That was the first thing I tried tinkering with, but it turned out not to be the case...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yuki, isn't there anything you can think of concerning this...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, you're the only one besides K who actually knows anything about songwriting, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<...
Mind if I listen to it again, K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, of course. You too, Enanan, Amia. Please let me know if anything comes to mind.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We came up empty in the end...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sorry, K. I wish we could be of better help...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, that's okay. Thanks to all of you, I think I have a better idea of what I need to do.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So, K, the rest is up to you...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes... I'll do my best to come up with some good ideas.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, there's something I wanna try doing if you don't mind hearing me out. What do you say?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No problem. We only got here a second ago and just started going through the menu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena and Mizuki are getting cake. What would you like, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Some sugar might be nice for recharging your brain.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right.
In that case, I think I'd like one of their little cakes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay.
Excuse me! We're ready to order!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, just meeting up at a different place makes this feel like such a new experience.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's nice for a change.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Although, I wasn't too sure at first about changing venues like this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, there's something I wanna try doing if you don't mind hearing me out. What do you say?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <A little change of pace. I thought we could work somewhere else by meeting up at a cafe or something!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, right. I've heard that it's actually pretty good to study at a cafe.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Like the audience effect or the co-action effect...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I think so!
Don't you study at cafes and stuff for that exact reason, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No, I mostly just use my cram school's studying room...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But my classmates from school seem to like studying at cafes and even say that it helps quite a bit.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<So, what do you think?
My hope is that a change of venue would help you come up with some good ideas.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I agree...
I don't want to waste more time than I already have, so I'd like to give it a try.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, our drinks and cakes are here, so why don't we get started...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are those your composition notebooks, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, they are.
I couldn't bring my computer here, so I decided to bring this instead.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, Kanade, is this how you write sheet music...?! It looks really simple, but also like you know exactly what you're doing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
And how thin these lines are... It's so clear that you wrote them, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought we came here to work.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, this might be my first time seeing the way everyone works...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ena's... Coloring where she left off yesterday. I think she's also going to finish balancing all the colors today.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mizuki seems to be working on where the lyric captions are going to appear.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's using... Her phone and a notepad? Oh, she's writing in her notepad as she looks at what's on her phone...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I was just seeing how you write lyrics for our songs...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you write cleaned-up versions of them in that notepad and not your smartphone?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I just use my phone to write whatever comes to mind...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
So, in general, you write everything in your notepad?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Not always.
I have my computer when I work at home.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Hey, I need a chocolate parfait set and a cake platter!

rows.Speaker: Customer A
rows.Line: And then, guess what happened next...?

rows.Speaker: Customer B
rows.Line: Haha! I didn't realize your senior was so mischievous! That totally changes my image of her!

rows.Speaker: Customer C
rows.Line: I want to take my puppy on a trip, but he's a real talker, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line:
Ours is the same.
The last thing we want is to cause trouble for anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Customer C
rows.Line: Exactly! Aren't there any vacation destinations that cater to furry companions like ours?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You seem to prefer somewhere more quiet, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sorry about that, Kanade.
I didn't mean to waste your time like that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it wasn't a waste.
I learned today that working while at a cafe probably isn't a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I got to see how you all go about your individual tasks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: True. You can't really see how others work on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right. So, I'm glad we did this.
Thank you for inviting me out, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If that's the case, I'm also really glad!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, Ms. Mochizuki's humming while stirring something in the pot...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ena did say how her job shadowing went incredibly well, and how she seems to have resolved her issue.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Ms. Yoisaki, hello!
I've made tomato stew with meatballs and plenty of vegetables for tonight's dinner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That looks delicious. Does it happen to be ready?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, please sit! I'll have some for you in a minute.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You seem much happier than usual, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? You were humming just now.
I was convinced that something good had happened to you recently.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
W-Was I?!
Oh no. At someone else's house no less...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I think I just made myself at home and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's okay.
I'm happy to hear that you feel so at ease.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here you are.
It's very hot, so please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mmm... Delicious.
I've always imagined tomatoes as being sour, but this is so good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's true that its sourness can overpower a dish, so I tried pouring in some honey to round out the flavor.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. I couldn't tell that you mixed in some honey.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, about what happened just a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? You mean when you were humming?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes. The thing is, Ms. Yoisaki, you guessed correctly. Something wonderful did happen.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Remember how you introduced me to Ena after speaking to you about the job shadowing that I'd be going on...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I heard from Ena that it went very well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It did. Thanks to her, my shadowing was a resounding success.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And it went as well as it did because you introduced me to her, Ms. Yoisaki. If you hadn't, I'm not sure how it would've gone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, thank you very much for what you did.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, all I did was introduce you to Ena.
If anything, she deserves more credit.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I made sure to thank her as much as I could during the shadowing! We even decided to meet up again, so I'm going to thank her again then.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound like old friends already. Are you going to practice drawing again?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll be doing sketches like an art class.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds a bit more serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Does this mean you've overcome your issues surrounding drawing and got really good or something?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I remember you saying how people saw the poster you made for the Cleanup Committee as an octopus holding rice cakes covered in red bean paste...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, some things happened and I ended up drawing the way I normally do with the kindergartners.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I feel somewhat bad for Ena after she went out of her way to teach me how to draw...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But she also said that she wanted to see me draw the way I normally do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That helped me quite a bit.
As a result, I went from disliking my art to embracing it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It sounds like you really enjoyed that shadowing as well, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Honami said that she learned to embrace her art.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (All I did was introduce them to each other...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm really glad to hear that them meeting produced such wonderful results.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll put the leftovers in the refrigerator and freezer, Ms. Yoisaki. Please start with what's in the refrigerator first.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll make sure to stick post notes on as usual that say how long you have to eat them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
Hm? These notes have drawings on them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Croquettes and...?
Um... Three sticks in a cup...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-It's the tomato veggie stew and meatballs...
I'm sorry. The three sticks are supposed to be the steam coming off it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: R-Right, there aren't any croquettes in this. I'm sorry. I should've recognized it since I just had it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, that's okay!
I'm sorry for making it so hard to tell!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So this is what meatballs look like when you draw them, Ms. Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd like it if you could draw more illustrations for me. I really want to see more of your art.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then, I'll try drawing some more next time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'm going to log off now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll take a look at the lyrics you wrote later.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <K, mind looking at my rough draft as well?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Mhm... I might log off too...
This seems like a good place for me to stop.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Ms. Mochizuki came over to my house yesterday and wanted to thank you for what you did during her job shadowing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She also seems to be really looking forward to you teaching her how to sketch next time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, you mean the housekeeper that you agreed to teach because she was having trouble drawing?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. She wanted someone to help build up her confidence before she painted with kindergarteners during her shadowing.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, I taught her a few tricks for drawing animals, and she got to the point of making them easily recognizable.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hang on. Does this Mochizuki person draw stuff in a way that makes her look like an abstract artist?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She was pretty conscious of that and wanted to learn how to draw things in a way that was easily recognizable to others. But...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's like the better she got, the more her individuality began to disappear.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And I began to worry if I'd done the right thing, even though I helped her achieve her goal.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, I asked Honami to draw like she normally does.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, she mentioned that to me.
And it seems to have helped quite a bit.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <In the end, Honami probably just needed to find a way to enjoy art more than learning how to draw per se.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sounds like you really did your best as a teacher, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I never play around when it comes to art if that's what you're implying.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Then don't say stuff like that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, I was really moved by what you did♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Once more, Enanan, thank you for agreeing to help Ms. Mochizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Especially since I haven't been able to give back to her despite her taking such good care of me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<But you helped me help her.
So, thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm glad that I could help you out somehow, K. And I'll always be willing to lend you a hand. It doesn't have to be just about art!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Um... F-Fashion, makeup and the latest trends...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, that could be helpful...
I really don't know much about those things.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <My sweats are usually enough for me, but I may need your help when it comes to actual clothes...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Sure thing, K!
I'll always be happy to teach you whatever you need to know!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry for keeping you like this, Enanan. You're free to go if you're done for the day.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, about that...!
If you don't mind, I'd like to wait until you finish checking my rough drafts.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, because working on the illustrations for other scenes while I wait will be a better use of my time.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Then, I'll take a look at it right now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (My initial hope was to have her teach Ms. Mochizuki how to draw, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Since you're all fired up and good to go, Enanan, can I ask you to make a couple more assets for me?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What are you piling on for?
It's gonna depend on what you actually want, so give it to me straight...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, I haven't actually agreed to anything yet!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This also ended up being a good experience for Ena. I'm really glad for her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll try changing the key here during this measure... Okay, that sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This seems like a good place for me to start going through the lyrics. Let's see... Mafuyu should've sent them to me already...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Hello, you two.
Yuki said she won't be able to make it today, so let's get started.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Alrighty!
I'm gonna keep looking for assets I can use in our video.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'm gonna pick up where I left off too. I should be able to finish my sketch pretty soon.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Are you gonna keep working on the key change for that one part you were talking about, K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, I actually finished doing that just a second ago. I was about to start going through Yuki's lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Her lyrics? Oh, the ones she was working on this afternoon?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, this afternoon...? Yuki was on Nightcord then?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, she said she wanted to keep working on them until she found a good place to stop before studying.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, I decided to stick around and hear about how your little sleepover went♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wait, you went behind my back...?
Also, why would you want to hear more about that?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, a person's room says a lot about who they are, right? I think it's always fun to hear about stuff like that♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I guess you're right. It sort of is an expression of their personality...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I really do need to do some cleaning...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But things have improved. At least I'm not accidentally kicking empty noodle cups and knocking over stacks of sheet music anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have Ms. Mochizuki to thank for that.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know that I'm not really in a position to say this, but make sure to keep your desk area clean, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That should make working a lot easier.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, I get it. You don't have to tell me twice. However, I like my desk the way it is because that's what's easier for me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, K, you'd rather have what you need at your fingertips, right? Arbitrarily cleaning your desk might actually make things harder for you...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I do think that I need to do some cleaning.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Now I see. You've been able to focus more on your work because your housekeeper friend has been periodically cleaning your room.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. It wasn't that big of an issue, but it was always annoying to have to restack my sheet music after I knocked it over...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, not having to do that anymore has been nice.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. Not only that, but going from eating instant noodles for every meal to a more gourmet menu is probably better for your health.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Although it's her job to clean my house, Ms. Mochizuki seems genuinely concerned about my well-being.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I need to properly thank her again sometime...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But what can I do for her...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Um, Enanan, Amia...
There's something I'd like to ask the both of you...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Do either of you know of any bakeries that sell good apple pies?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <A bakery that sells good apple pies?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, Ms. Mochizuki... I mean, my housekeeper... She likes apple pies very much, so I was thinking that we could have some together the next time she came over.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's a great idea! I'm sure Honami's gonna really love it when she hears that you bought them for her, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Gimme one second. I remember writing down the names of some really good places that sell apple pies and tarts.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I think I know a good place too. Lemme look it up!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Aha! Found it... Okay, this specialty shop on Main Street's gotta be my top recommendation!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, that place! I've had their apple pie before! It was sooo good!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A specialty shop...? I had no idea...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <They seem to get a lot of repeat customers because you get to choose how cinnamon-y the crust is, and if you want cocoa powder and other stuff on it!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <They only use the best ingredients, and you can buy ones that are fresh out of the oven.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Lemme post the URL in chat.
Here...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The picture of the bag they have on their website... It looks familiar...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think Ms. Mochizuki brought some apple pies over from this shop before.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Darn. I guess it's only natural for an apple pie lover like her to know about this shop.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... If that's the case, she might know about all of the other shops in town.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
