rows.Line: <You kinda want to surprise her with an apple pie from a place she's never been to before, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah... Alright, then, how about this one?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It just opened up by the station, and everyone's talking about how crispy they make their crusts!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh... We had some together from this shop just last week...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Grr... Strike two!
I'll admit, she is quick.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<K, how about here?
It's inside the shopping mall...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's every apple pie shop in Shibuya...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sorry, K, I wish we could actually help...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, that's okay. If anything, I should be the one apologizing for making you two look up all these shops...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I really appreciate you finding them for me since I couldn't remember the names of some of these places despite having their apple pies.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'll try buying some from the first shop you showed me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I hope Honami likes what you get for her.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness I was able to buy these apple pies...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was worried that they'd sell out after seeing that massive line coming out of the store.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that ended up taking longer than I was expecting. I should get home before Ms. Mochizuki arrives.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hm? Ms. Yoisaki?
Were you out just now?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I was out buying something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That bag. It's from the apple pie shop on Main Street, yes? Were you out buying...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, some of their apple pies.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're always doing so much for me, so I thought that I could give back to you somehow today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, you didn't need to do that...!
I'm just doing my job.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That may be so, but I can't thank you enough for always cooking delicious food and cleaning my room for me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, let's have some of these apple pies together when it's snack time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to find some scented oils that we liked.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. There were so many at first that I really didn't know which to choose...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we really started having fun partway through.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all enjoyed yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Next, why don't we choose some flowers to put inside our scented candles?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, dried flowers to be exact.
They can help give a candle a more elegant look when placed inside of its wax.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh wow. This one looks like it has a flower inside it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I believe that's a hydrangea. It's so vivid and pretty...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It looks like they have several with different species of flowers in them. Oh, this one even has an orange and other fruits in it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It does. That's really cute...
The others would probably be so startled if I made something like this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That means our candles might turn out like the ones we saw earlier.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They'd look so pretty and colorful. Ena and the others would probably like that.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, they have so many different kinds of dried flowers. Um... This one looks kinda familiar, but I forget its name...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's baby's-breath. The ones next to them are petunias and... Oh, they even have lavender and starflowers!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really do know your flowers, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, just their names if I'm going to be honest...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. The truth is, I'm always asking Ichika for advice regarding which flowers to take over to your house, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only can she tell me what's in season, but she can also tell me about their symbolism.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's nothing special. This is just a hobby of mine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I really appreciate what you do. The flowers you suggest have this way of brightening up my house.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, would you mind helping me pick out some today?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, can you help me too...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, I'd be more than happy to.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should have just enough room to fit one of these larger flowers, so please keep that in mind. Outside of that, you should be free to choose whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, we'll probably want to choose ones that go with each candle's design.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We can also choose ones that are in season...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For example, pheasant's-eye and daffodils... Plum blossoms and camellias should also be in bloom soon.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Pheasant's-eye...? Oh, these. They come in such a beautiful yellow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
They have an interesting name too.
I wonder what they symbolize...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, they're supposed to symbolize “forthcoming happiness” or “eternal good fortune”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, you knew that off the top of your head...? You really do know a lot about flowers.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Why don't we keep asking our teacher Ms. Ichika here any questions that we have while choosing our flowers?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for doing this, Ms. Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to thank you as well, Ms. Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-You're both going along with this?! Again, what I do is really nothing special...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for teaching us so much today, Hoshino. I was able to pick out the right flowers because of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. You teaching us what our flowers symbolize helped so much. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I had fun as well. When I was double-checking, it was interesting to learn that certain flowers symbolized other things on top of what I already knew.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you very much, Ms. Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All that's left is to make our candles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I hope our candles turn out well.
And I really hope everyone likes them.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My rough mix is mostly complete, so I think I'll have everyone listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, but it still isn't 25:00... They might not be on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm here too. Yuki should also still be on.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But I have to leave in a little bit...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Then, I know this is a bit sudden, but do you all have some time to listen to my rough mix? I'll send it over now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. I needed a quick break anyway.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Then, I'll give it a listen too.
Humhumhuuum♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hm? Oh, that was me.
I just lit the scented candle you gave me, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I've been using it lately whenever I take a break from working. Plus, it looks super cute and it smells great. I really love it!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... As much as I want to use mine... It seems like a shame for me to since it was a gift from K...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I kind of would like for you to use it. I chose a fragrance that I thought suits you, and if you like it, I'll be more than happy to make you another one.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?! You'll make me another one?!
Then, I'll light it right away! Be right back.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yuki, have you tried using your scented candle yet?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think I was able to focus a little more than usual...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Huh?
Shouldn't you be commenting more on how it smells and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Says the person who hasn't lit her candle yet...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, I said I was saving mine!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Um...
Was its fragrance to your liking?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. It seemed to help clear my head. What is it exactly...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<That should be the mint.
In your candle, Yuki, I also mixed in some woody scents like cypress.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, while we're on the subject... Did your mom say anything about it? I hope she didn't get mad at you for using a scented candle...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I told her that a friend gave it to me as a gift for Valentine's Day.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She seemed okay with it after I explained how it should help me focus more while I do my homework and such.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wow, it's starting to smell really nice...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's kinda sweet... But citrusy at the same time.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I chose a more floral fragrance for your candle, Enanan, and an orange one for a bit of an accent.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wow, you came up with that combination just for me?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I chose the base fragrance.
Ms. Mochizuki showed me that I can mix in something else fairly easily.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She must be superwoman or something. On top of being a great cook and housekeeper, she knows how to make scented candles.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, and she helped me out quite a bit this time.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, I've finished listening to your mix...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, hold on! I haven't finished listening to it yet!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, let's wait and give Enanan a chance to listen to it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know your candle smells really nice, Enanan, so don't fall asleep on us.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, be quiet. I'm trying to listen here.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Great... Sounds much better with those bass adjustments. It accentuates the melody while still asserting its presence.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now to take a closer look at the sound balance...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? A DM... It's from Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
“It's time”...?
But it's only midnight. Why...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I was starting to get really worried you wouldn't show up!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, here we go. One, two, three...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you everyone, you didn't have to do this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No worries. We're the ones who suggested it, after all!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Looking forward to another year with you, K!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Looking forward to another year with you too, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Sorry... I need to sleep soon, so I'll be logging off.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Thanks for staying up late, I know you're busy. Talk to you tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Shouldn't you two get to bed on the early side, too? Didn't you say you're gonna go hang out at SpoJoy Park tomorrow...er, today?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You're right. Once I've made it to a good stopping point, I think I'll do just that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm afraid I'll oversleep and miss it, so I'll do that, too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Poor, poor me is going to be stuck working, so have extra fun for my sake.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yeah, thanks.
And good luck at work, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Oh, hello Kanade. I see you're visiting today, too. Please take your time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh... He looks like he's sleeping really peacefully...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's a little lonely not being able to celebrate it with you... But my friends said they would celebrate with me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Happy Birthday Kanade♪ Enjoy Your Day at SpoJoy,” starting now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... Enjoy Your Day at SpoJoy?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it's all the naming I've been doing for segments on our stream, I just felt like putting a name on it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Kanade.
Thank you for coming, I know we suggested this on pretty short notice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I'm the one who's grateful.
I was happy when you suggested getting together to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We've come here with Minori and Ichika before, but it's your first time, right Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I've heard from Ichika that you had a really good time, so I'm very much looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh yeah! I saw this on the homepage, but apparently they do something special for you here if it's your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! I'll go ask a staff member now!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Hello!
We wish you a happy birthday today!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: This is your special birthday cake hat and “Today's star” sash! Here you are!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, ew...no, I mean!
That sash is very... bold!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Haha...
Oh, the hat is shaped like a cake, it's very cute!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Though it looks a bit heavy...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Okay then, time for your picture!
Let's see a happy ★ peace sign!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Alright, let's have everyone join in as well! We have matching sashes and hats.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Uh...
Okay, can I just have the hat, please...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Alright, picture time!
Everybody now! Happy ★ peace!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That caught me off guard, but... I think the pictures they took will make for a good memory.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's great, Kanade.
Okay, should we get to exercising?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is there anything you and Kanade want to do?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm... Since we're back, I want to try something we didn't do last time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, how about that over there?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Basketball, huh? We didn't do it last time, so it might be nice. I don't have any confidence in my speed, though...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Same here. I've played a little for gym class, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Then, we'll start with dribbling!
Here's a ball!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Give it your best, Ms. Yoisaki!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. Um... I guess I'm only allowed to use one hand for this. There—

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Whoa! I-I only did it lightly and it bounced that much? W-Wait...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huff...I finally made it back.
I can't believe it rolled that far...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Haha. Nice work out there, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well then, let's refocus and have someone give us a demonstration! Hanasato, if you would.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're so good!
Minori, you can play basketball?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. Haruka taught me some techniques once.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I see! Hey, can we see you shoot?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You got it! Here I go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Amazing...
She reached the basket in the blink of an eye.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And she's going straight for a shot...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm sorry!
I forgot how to make a shot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You almost had it, Ichika!
You would've gotten a spare if the ball went just a little further to the right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I really hope I get a strike next time.
Kanade, it's your turn.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It's rolling so slow!
But as long as it doesn't stop...!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
It fell into the gutter right at the end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'll get it next time, that was so close!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Momentum is important too, Kanade!
Give it everything you've got!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! You're okay as long as you don't step on the foul line, so try to throw from as close as possible!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mhm!
Keep it up, keep it up, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone.
Alright, I'll make my second throw.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Momentum...as close to the line as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You did it, Kanade! You knocked down three of the pins!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I was finally able to reach the pins thanks to all of your advice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now if you can just add more momentum, shouldn't you be able to get a strike?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree.
You still have plenty of chances, so do your best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh! Kanade, even your form has gotten much better!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't you think this could be it?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, so close! The four pins on the left are still standing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But now you can aim for a spare!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's a spare, you did it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. She wants to high five, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone.
It took two games, but I finally feel like I'm actually bowling.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Should we go for game three?
You can aim for that strike next!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Honestly, I'm pretty tired, but...
Our scores have been getting better and all, so I'll keep going if you want to.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
In that case, maybe I'll try pushing myself too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Yoisaki.
Hoshino invited me to join you at SpoJoy Park, but I couldn't because of our show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...I'd really like it if we could sit down to talk about music sometime. I want to know how you compose your songs, for one thing... And um, if you like, please do come see another one of our shows.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade!
SpoJoy Park sure was fun. I felt so moved when we high-fived during bowling!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It doesn't have to be for a special occasion like your birthday, but feel free to invite me anytime you want to take a breather! I'll help fill you up with energy, if you don't mind my company!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
Getting songwriting advice, exercising, making scented candles...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's been a lot of fun being able to do all kinds of things with you lately. And...I hope you don't mind me inviting you again when another opportunity comes around!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki. I think basketball and bowling made for a nice workout. I'm sure you're tired, so I'll bring a nutritious meal that'll help you recover.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll keep doing my best to help you in any way I can, so I look forward to spending more time together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I never would've thought I'd end up exercising so much on your birthday, Kanade. My arms and legs are throbbing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Sounds like both of you are sore from your workout, just the way it should be♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean “the way it should be”? I'm in pain over here, I can't even lift my arms.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's because you don't exercise regularly...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Exactly! For your health, we need you to eat well and exercise well! Starting with eating three meals a day, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I do think it would be better to eat properly.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel the same about that. We want you to be able to make lots more songs, Kanade. So take better care of yourself, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I felt the same thing the last time I went to SpoJoy Park, too, but I guess it's possible to have a comfortable sense of exhaustion.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Getting together with everyone to have some fun, and even high fiving each other...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess spending my birthday like this isn't so bad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I really wasn't expecting that to happen...
My hope was that coming here would help clear my head.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She actually told her mom that she didn't want to give up music.)

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <I would like for you and Yuki to stop working on this music of yours.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <She is in pursuit of a different dream that doesn't involve music. If you truly are her friend, I'm sure you'd want her to focus on her studies.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (There isn't much I can do for Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I need to do my best to express what I felt and how Mafuyu feels to her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I should go to bed soon. I need as much rest as I can get for tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I can work for a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (No matter how much I fiddle with this bridge, I can't seem to get it right...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, you're right! K, I didn't know you were here.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You're up pretty late.
Are you sure you don't need to sleep? You're meeting Yuki's mom tomorrow, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I am. I was planning on going to bed early, but I started feeling really anxious...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Speaking of which, K...
What are you gonna wear tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Good question... You're not going in your sweats, are you?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um... I have this blouse I used to wear during junior high school. I was thinking about putting that on...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She probably won't take me very seriously if I went in my usual sweats.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah... I've got a feeling that Mafuyu's mom is super picky about stuff like that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, I'm glad I still have it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The others have told me about their impressions of her... But I wonder what she's really like...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Um, K...?
Wanna work together for a bit?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We can talk while we do. That might help you relax.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay...
I'll keep working a bit longer.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, Enanan.
There's this new asset I wanna add. Would you mind?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Here I thought we were done after this one I'm working on... What is it that you wanna add?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<It's for the girl during the interlude...
I kinda want her to have a slightly different expression.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Okay, that's much better.
This bridge should do nicely...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was having so much trouble just a second ago, but I figured it out immediately after we began working together.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, it might be better if her expression was a little different here. So, what did specifically you have in mind...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Awesome! You're the best, Enanan!
I'm sending over a reference pic now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Enanan, Amia...
I need to log off soon.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Let us know if anything happens tomorrow, okay? We'll be right over to help.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'll keep my phone on standby too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I promise to do my best for both of you too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'll make myself some tea...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I managed to tell Mafuyu's mom everything that I needed her to hear...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I agree that Mafuyu and I will need to have a little heart to heart...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Which should give her an opportunity to see that she doesn't need your silly, little group and that becoming a doctor is what's best for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll be back to normal after we've had a chance to talk things over...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't believe a word you're saying...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I refuse to leave Mafuyu's side...
Regardless of what you say...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If things keep up, Mafuyu's true feelings are going to be suppressed completely by her mom.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Just when she's finally figured out how to say what she herself wants to do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But even that little wish was pulverized...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Again, I don't believe that she has Mafuyu's best interests in mind...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She severely restricts what her daughter's allowed to do... Including expressing how she feels... She's treating Mafuyu like a...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, you're really pale!
What happened? You're not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(That marionette Mafuyu saw...
It made her feel sick because...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's mom has been trying to keep her from doing or feeling what she wants, and she really hates it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (As a result, she began losing sight of who she really is...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (While living in that horrible environment this whole time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I felt shivers run down my spine as I spoke with Mafuyu's mom... Even after coming home, my hands still feel so cold...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh no! I left the water running...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right. I was going to make tea...
Let's see. Which one should I have...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (There's still some of the herbal tea Ms. Mochizuki brought over the other day. I'll have some of that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This tea has such a nice aroma to it.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I think she said that it's supposed to help you relax and clear your mind.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's only every once in a while, but I really appreciate how she puts so much thought into what teas to bring over...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Not just my hands and the rest of my body, but... My heart too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If only there was a way for me to share this warmth with Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I want to stay by her side.
No, I have to stay by her side.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... It was somewhere around...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, here it is☆
Kanade, Mizuki, over here♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, this is the bouquet workshop...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It doesn't look too crowded right now.
You might actually be able to make a bouquet for Honami while she shops for souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Otori, Mizuki, thank you both for helping me out like this so suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is there anything you wanna get, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, would you mind if I asked you two for a favor first...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to thank Ms. Mochizuki somehow for inviting us out today and for everything she helps me with. Do you have any suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Is that what you meant by a favor?
Hmm... Flowers are the first thing that comes to mind for me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, there's this place where you can make a bouquet!
They have staff there to help, so anyone can do it♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's perfect!
And it totally goes with the bridal fair theme!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it does...
Then, I think I'll do that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't mention it!
More importantly, you should probably go register now.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Okay, please choose whichever flowers you'd like to use from here.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: You may also refer to this sheet if you'd like to know their names as well as what they symbolize.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! These flowers are all so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And it's pretty cool that they let you know what each flower symbolizes! So, Kanade, which do you wanna use?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well... Forget-me-nots apparently symbolize “true love”, while pink gladioli symbolize “earnest love”...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess it makes sense that a lot of these focus on love since it is a wedding bouquet. Oh, these flowers seem to be about appreciation!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Let's see what they have...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did you find some that you like?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it says that these white dahlias symbolize “appreciation” and “abundant love”.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki brings over dahlias from time to time, so I thought she'd like seeing some familiar flowers.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's really nice♪ Also, “abundant love” goes really well with Honami's personality!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was also thinking about using these bluestars since they look so pretty...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... They symbolize “love and happiness”, and “believing in one another”!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's perfect!
You did just give each other your vows earlier today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Do you take one another as wedded spouses for better, for worse, in sickness and in health, to love and to cherish from this day forth?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Kanade, what else do you wanna use?
There's still lots more flowers to choose from☆

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure. I don't know which to choose... Actually, could I ask you two for some recommendations?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Then, as your cupids, we shall lovingly bestow our advice upon you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, you've got your flowers!
Now you just gotta put your bouquet together♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, the dahlias are gonna take center stage?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, followed by the bluestars.
Then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... How about some roses for a little more color?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
So... L-Like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! The dahlias turned the other way!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? I thought I had a good grip on them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here, I'll hold the stems.
They shouldn't turn or anything if I can keep them steady like this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, Kanade, I'll hand you the flowers♪
Which do you want next?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much...
Next, I think...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want them to face forward more, like this... And there's a gap here that I'll need to fill.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. The corner for the bouquet exhibit's supposed to be around here somewhere. I was hoping to take a look at it, so would it be okay if we went there next?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It must be all the fresh-cut flowers.
The roses, the lilies of the valley... So many gentle fragrances all mixing together. It's very soothing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely! And there aren't that many people here, probably since this exhibit's way in the back. We can relax here for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What did you think, Kanade?!
Did you enjoy our special show?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Ms. Mochizuki's such a nice person...
She's so considerate that she's probably been worrying about me, even when I'm not around.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Including how she invited me out for today's fair...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This is so strange... On the surface, I feel sorry for causing her so much trouble. But deep down, I feel this warmth beginning to well up...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's all the more reason for me to show her my appreciation.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
All good!
Honami hasn't returned yet.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
All that's left is for you to give her the bouquet you made♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She'll be coming over to my house after this, so I'll try to give these to her at the right time there.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki, Otori, thank you both very much for helping me. I was able to make a very nice bouquet for her as a result.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I hope Honami really likes it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. I'm looking forward to giving this to her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki, does this look like enough rice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you very much.
I'll move the entrees to the table now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The stew smells nice...
I can feel my appetite growing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. Also, thank you again for allowing me to stay for dinner like this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We did make it together after all.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: On top of that... I felt like having dinner with someone else today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Of course.
So, shall we take our seats?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This stew's so rich...
Especially considering how quickly we made it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Ms. Yoisaki, look...
These are the carrots you cut.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now that I'm seeing them like this, they seem smaller than the other ingredients...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Carrots tend to maintain their shape when stewed, so I think you did a nice job by cutting them into bite-sized pieces.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And... Yes, they've soaked up quite a bit of flavor.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This meal feels more rejuvenating than usual for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It may be that you were in need of something nutritious.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We walked quite a bit at the bridal fair, and even participated in that wedding show.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I might've walked even more than the other day when I went walking with Ena.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It was such a big fair as well.
We had so much fun seeing all the exhibits and such.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, and I think we learned quite a lot about dresses since Mizuki was nice enough to explain.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. That was incredibly helpful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki seemed to have a lot of fun, so I'm glad we had an extra invitation.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Also, Otori was a very interesting person.
Is she like that at school as well?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, she's always full of energy and has a talent for making the people around her smile.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. I can see her doing that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She also helped come up with the idea for the show we participated in today, yes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Wonderlands×Showtime really did come up with a fun and lively show for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Although, I was surprised when I heard that we'd be dealing with a vampire...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. I hope I didn't overstay my welcome.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's my pleasure.
If anything, thank you for staying for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The bath should be ready soon, so please rest today and give your body a chance to recover.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Again, thank you for inviting me.
I really enjoyed what we did today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I had a lot of fun as well.
Not only that, this bouquet you gave me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I promise to treasure it.
Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The bath should be ready in about five minutes. I'll go get my bath towel and all that ready now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I almost forgot. I'll try using some of those bath salts Ms. Mochizuki brought over the other day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what's in this set.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Something may've happened to her phone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're able to see what's going on over in your world by using the functionality of your phones.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, does this mean her phone's broken?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
B-But, I mean... Now?
That seems like way too big a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I agree that Mafuyu and I will need to have a little heart to heart...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Which should give her an opportunity to see that she doesn't need your silly, little group and that becoming a doctor is what's best for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll be back to normal after we've had a chance to talk things over...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (As much as I don't want to think about it, what if her mom did do something...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(If she really did...
That means I should've been more careful.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I think I'd convinced myself that she wouldn't do anything to Mafuyu's phone even under the worst circumstances...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Ena said she just got to Miya Girls!
But Mafuyu apparently left already...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
Oh... I'm at the CD shop right now, but no sign of her here either...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Same with the station...
I'm about to go check out the diner where we usually have our after-parties!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sounds good. Then, I'll try looking for her at the mall...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I will. Talk to you later.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I finally made it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(My legs feel so heavy...
I thought I'd been exercising more than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But I don't have time to rest...
I need to keep looking for Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I have some good news for you.
Miku and KAITO were able to reach Mafuyu's phone.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Where is she?
No, more importantly, did you find out what happened?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
And her phone fell into her aquarium...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I didn't think she'd resort to that, but she actually tried to take Mafuyu's phone away...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So, how about Mafuyu...?
She said she was going to tell her mom how she really feels...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, she was apparently on her way home to do just that.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Don't worry. Well, I'm not really in a position to be saying that... But Miku and KAITO are there with her.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'm sure Mafuyu will appreciate having them there with her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Now that we've found her, why don't you head home for now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
Oh, I should let Mizuki and Ena know...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<We've got that covered.
MEIKO said she'd go tell them what happened.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I suppose there isn't much point in lingering here any longer. I should follow Luka's advice and head home for...)

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: Hey, it got really dark and cloudy all of a sudden. Do you think it's gonna rain...?

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: Wait, I didn't bring an umbrella...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, they're right...
It did suddenly get very dark.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You should get home before it starts coming down.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Luka, thank you for letting me know how Mafuyu's doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Of course.
Anyway, I'll let you know if I hear any further news.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness I was able to get home before it started raining.

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line: <Kanade, Mizuki, are you both home already?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line:
<I am!
I was just about to log onto Nightcord.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It might be faster for me to tell them on Nightcord...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Luka said she went over to tell you what happened with Mafuyu. Has she told you already?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. She said Mafuyu went home to talk to her mom...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She apparently almost had her phone taken away, but I guess that sort of gave her the push she needed, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You mean whether she can properly tell her mom how she really feels?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You're worried about what Mafuyu's mom will do, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because up until now, Mafuyu probably just kept doing what her mom told her to do...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <To put it bluntly, she's about to bite the hand that feeds her...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But she hasn't been able to say how she really feels all this time...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Her having to keep quiet just doesn't seem right, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I get what you mean...
But getting her mom to understand is like a completely different problem altogether...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu means the world to me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Ever since she was little, she's been a kind and polite girl... That's why I want to make her the happiest person in the world.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It saddens me to see that you're misunderstanding my intentions, but I want you to know that I care about her deeply.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She claims that she cares about Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm having a hard time believing her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which begs the question... Will she even listen to what her daughter has to say?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We heard that you guys were home, so we came to see how you're all doing...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? What's going on? Did Rin and Len come over?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Y-Yeah...
We were having trouble just waiting around...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<They're waiting in SEKAI...
Just in case they hear back from Miku and KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I guess we're all really worried.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She'll probably be okay since Miku and KAITO are with her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But each second feels like an eternity right now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Did the others feel the same thing I did when they spoke to Mafuyu's mom...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It was sprinkling before, but it's really starting to come down. How perfect for our current situation...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <For now, let's just believe in Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If she does end up needing our help...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We have to be there for her.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We'll also help in any way we can...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I took it a little too easy on my walk over. He does usually fall asleep around this time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The new terms for Kamiyama High and Miya Girls will be starting soon. Our group is about to become a mix of second and third-years...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The girl who's been coming over to make food for me even said how she's nervous and excited about becoming a second-year.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, she said her band has signed with a label and they will be debuting as pros soon.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Isn't that incredible?
They're on their way to making their dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I need to do the same...
I need to compose a song that will save Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have to get back to work right when I get home, start on the demo for our next song and...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I thought it was you!
It's been a while!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Hanasato...
Were you in the middle of a run?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! I was actually just about to head home, but I decided to come talk to you after seeing you on the other side of the road!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You went out of your way to come talk to me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I've been wondering how you've been since we haven't seen each other in so long!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's really sunny out today, but how are you? Do you feel tired at all?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, but I'm not carrying much today. I should be fine as long as I take my time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but there is a convenience store just around the corner. Wanna take a quick break there? I could use something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, a little break does sound nice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whew...
There's nothing better than a sports drink after a nice run!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Some ice cream as a reward! Here, Kanade, this one's for you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That reminds me. Ms. Mochizuki said that you'll be on the credit-based course as a second-year, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! I made the switch after deciding that I wanted to do more than ever before as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And when we've really made a name for ourselves, we're gonna do a show at the Dome!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm having trouble picturing it since it's so big scale, but I think it's a wonderful dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, darn it. I didn't win anything...
To be fair, I never do with these things...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, can you win things with these? Let's see if mine...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Congratulations, Kanade! You drew a winner!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is great!
How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I actually felt happy about something...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(This chord still doesn't seem right...
But it's technically the sound I'm looking for...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe I should try playing this song again from the beginning.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? Someone just logged it...
Oh, it's Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Hello? Amia...?
I thought you said you'd be at school today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I did go. But only until noon♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <My teacher and classmates were so surprised when they saw me there this morning.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But the person sitting in front of me wasn't surprised at all.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No way. There was a class that I thought I needed to attend this morning.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm also trying to stay on top of my attendance from the get-go so that I don't have to suffer through more supplementary classes.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right. Mizuki had to take supplementary classes in order to actually become a second-year.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You seem to have a lot on your plate...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <A little. Fortunately, my new class seems like a lot of fun, so that's a plus.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I doubt many people expected so many interesting characters to be placed in the same class.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, do you have any fun memories regarding that?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, I was actually trying to remember what happened... But I having trouble recalling.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm... I guess that means nothing memorable happened, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You never even had that “Wow, we're in the same class again♪” conversation with someone?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <“Oh, you don't know anyone in this class too? Neither do I. I'm glad there's someone who's in the same boat...”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That sounds likely, but I don't remember...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, how about things you do remember...?! What can you recall from when you moved up a grade and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I do remember something that happened during this one opening ceremony...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So... You're normally seated alphabetically for those, right? Because of that, I always ended up somewhere towards the back.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm not very tall, so I couldn't see who was speaking on stage... I even resorted to seeing between people and jumping up and down.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Wait, what?!
No way! That's so cute!>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I... I still can't see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't remember trying as hard as you think I did, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really? But trying to see between people and jumping up and down's way too cute!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
Anyway, what else can you recall?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I should get back to work soon...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Aww, really?!
Fine, I guess I should do the same.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Still, K, thanks for telling me that.
I feel way more motivated about working now! I'm gonna do my best♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That was nice since I did get a little stuck back there. Now then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Everything up to the pre-chorus sounds much better now. Now I just need to work on tying the chorus and interlude together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, anyone there?
I'm back after working my tush off at work.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Welcome back.
Did you have an early shift today?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, K! Yeah, I did!
There was a movie I wanted to see at night, so I asked someone to switch with me♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hi, K... Oh, Amia, you're here too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, Enanan! All done with art class?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I can't exactly log in from there, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, that reminds me.
I saw a really wholesome sight on my way home.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, pretty sure I spotted some first-years from one of the other schools. They looked like they hadn't quite figured out how they wanted to wear their uniforms yet.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <They seemed so excited about their new lives and situations that they couldn't really contain themselves.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Really...? It's already that time of year...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. Even though not too long ago, the real possibility of being held back had Mizuki panicking.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, I wasn't the only one.
Li'l Bro was in the same situation.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, attendance was my problem. I wasn't in trouble for failing a bunch of tests.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I have nothing to do with Akito's grades.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<What?! You're so cold!
Even though you've been asking him to be your human alarm clock anytime you have something going on.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, speaking of alarms...
Amia, don't forget to set yours so that you actually get up in the morning tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Kamiyama High's having theirs tomorrow...?
Are the night school students also going?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No, but ours is on the same day.
It'll take place when we normally have classes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, K, what about your correspondence school? Do they hold opening ceremonies and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, mine does. We're supposed to attend those sorts of ceremonies and events when we can.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I didn't know that.
When is your school's?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Uhh... Good question...
They should be sending me an email, but...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, they sent me one about the opening ceremony three weeks ago... When is it...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, talk about cutting it close! It's a good thing you realized!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <W-Wow. So, what am I going to need...? Wait, clothes. They probably won't let me go in sweats...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Try to calm down, K! You still have time! Start by reading through the whole email!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Phew...
Thank goodness. I should be okay as long as I start preparing for it now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Man, I thought you were done for when you said it was tomorrow♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you both very much.
I probably would've missed it if we didn't have this conversation.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha! Us being so chatty ended up saving your skin.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, it doesn't seem all that unusual.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. We should tell Yuki about this when she gets here, and let her know that being talkative has its benefits.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I dunno. I feel like eighty percent of what we talk about is pretty meaningless.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(The opening ceremony...
I didn't think I'd be attending another school event.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They might be a good source of inspiration once in a while.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should set an alarm now since I'll probably forget between working and napping.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Kanade, are you okay...?
You look exhausted. It has been a while since we last went out for a walk.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay...
I can keep going for a bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright. Then, let's keep going. Our goal's just up ahead.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Phew...
I'm tired, but that felt good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I might fall asleep after I get home and take a shower.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me too. Now if only the vending machine at the park wasn't sold out of sports drinks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, Kanade, I thought you did great. You had to take a lot fewer breaks compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You did your best to match my pace that time. I felt a little bad about that actually...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, don't be sorry.
I'm just happy that you invited me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But what made you want to go for a walk? Are your shoulders bothering you again?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, it just felt like too much time had passed since our last walk.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, look! There's a vending machine! Mind if I go see if they have any sports drinks...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In that case, I'll go with you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll get one for you while I'm at it, so you just rest. There should be a park just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Are you sure...?
Well, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course. I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's nice to see you too, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... What were you doing just now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry for making you wait, Kusanagi.
Huh? Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We made plans to practice singing together here today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Would you like to listen to us for a bit, Kanade?
I'd love to hear what you think...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... Please, if you don't mind!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I told Ena that I'd wait here, so I guess I can stay until she gets here...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Great! Then, we just need a second to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can feel my mind and body being enveloped by this gentle warmth...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're all looking forward to making their dreams come true by overcoming any obstacles that come their way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Seeing that made me want to do the same and try just as hard.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(It's like she said.
Everyone's doing their best each day.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Thank you for giving me another boost of encouragement, Hoshino, Kusanagi.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, I just sent you those lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. I'll start looking over them now, Yuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (How many days has it been since Mafuyu started staying over...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Her being here still feels a little strange for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I haven't eaten anything...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Would you like to have something as well, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm okay for now.
But you should probably have something.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But your dad may start worrying if you don't have at least a little bit to eat...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I'll heat up some food.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can heat up the stew in the microwave... And these look like pickles. We can have these as is.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's okay. I'll prepare everything today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, it's ready...
Let's see... I should probably put these on some plates.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How about these ones? They should be big enough.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, I think the kettle's empty.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're right... I completely forgot about that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Despite saying that I was going to do everything, she ended up helping me out anyway...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Still, Mafuyu does seem to be feeling better compared to before...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She seemed like she was in so much pain at that time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I mean, how could she not be after what happened to her...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Why don't you come inside, Mafuyu? You'll catch a cold...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can't really be with Mafuyu while she takes a bath, but I hope that helps warm her back up...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I should still have some of that tea Ms. Mochizuki brought over, so I can also brew some of that for her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anything to help calm her nerves... Even if it's just a little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She said she told that person everything. Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can't let Mafuyu go back to that place.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hello? This is Yoisaki. I apologize for contacting you at such a late hour. I have some news regarding Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, at the moment, she's taking a bath...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I believe that it would be best if she spent the night here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right now, she needs time to settle down and gather her thoughts...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If anything does come up, I promise to let you know right away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, thank you for the bath.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu...
Do you feel a little warmer now?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(She seems a little better.
But her hair's still soaked...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She probably doesn't even have the energy to worry about it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're going to catch a cold if you don't dry your hair. Come here and I'll help...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The meat and potato stew's ready.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Thank you.
Mafuyu, please sit. Let's have some together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want today to be nice and relaxing for her.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to leave for school...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
Do you know when you'll be back?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should be able to come back early since we don't have club activities today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She seems much better now compared to when she first started staying over...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you going to keep working, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, you should at least take a quick nap. You stayed up all night working, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, you usually fall asleep at your desk. You should be sleeping in your bed instead.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should get my act together if I don't want Mafuyu to worry so much.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe something simpler would be better.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That didn't work... Then, how about...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You weren't also working just now, were you, Amia...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, I was watching an anime marathon!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sorry... I know there isn't much for you to do until I'm finished working on this demo...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Don't worry about me! Also, there's no rush! I mean, a lot did happen recently.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Take your time and make it a good one♪ In the meantime, I'll try to hone my craft by watching some good works.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, K, Amia, you're both already here. Were you both working just now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I'm still a little lost, but I'm slowly making progress.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I mean, is she gonna be okay?
She still seemed pretty down about what happened.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I'm also a little worried...
But I want to respect her decision to go. She said there are no club activities today, so she should be back early.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay...
Yeah, I guess she should go if she thinks she can.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But if anything does happen, let me know! I'll be right over to help!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you...
If the situation arises, then I'll be calling on you both.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'm going to mute myself and get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now, if I can just finalize this part...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? Oh, someone's at the door...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I almost fell over in my own room...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hmm... I really need to clean up soon...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: B-Be right there! Just give me one second...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
M-Mafuyu... I'm so sorry...!
I didn't hear the doorbell ring...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's okay.
This is your house after all.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But that's no excuse for me to...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm trying to provide her with a place of refuge, but if I keep doing these things...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... I feel really guilty about what just happened. I should try to find a way to prevent this from happening again.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You don't have to do that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know. What if I gave you my key?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, you wouldn't be able to go anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That shouldn't be a problem since I hardly ever leave the house. Wait, visiting the hospital won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm okay with things just the way they are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, you should be able to treat this house as your own while you're staying here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
Maybe I should have a spare key made for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That way, we'd both be able to come and go as we please.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I am. I'll go have one made.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good morning...
I'm about to get breakfast ready. Would you like some?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You tried to suppress whatever you were feeling just now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Before you formed N25, and even now... The songs you've composed have helped me so much.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<So, Kanade...
I think you should also do what makes you the happiest.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Right. I must've fallen asleep while thinking about what they said...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. Could you repeat that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Did something happen after I went to bed last night...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... I got a little stuck while working and decided to head over to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: One thing led to another, and I ended up reminiscing about the first song I ever composed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The first song you ever composed...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Give me a second.
Umm, it went like...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I could tell that you composed it because you told me that it was one of your songs.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm not sure I would've been able to if you hadn't.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right.
It feels a little strange even to me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this song's somewhat similar to the one you composed the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know how to describe it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I thought it was good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Are you talking about that one time you smiled...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Actually, didn't I also compose that one with Mom and Dad specifically in mind?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's able to feel many more things now. And if I want her to keep smiling...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If there is something you wish to do, you shouldn't fight against it.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Because there's no way you'll be able to save her if you don't cherish your own feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What I wish to do... How I really feel...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If it's okay for me to have that sort of hope...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Then I might try composing a song about it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Back then, I didn't have any technical skills or knowledge when it came to music. I really just composed as I went along...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was driven by the excitement I felt while playing the keyboard, and I was overcome with joy when I got the sound I wanted.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I remember staring at Dad's back while he composed. I kept wondering what was going through his mind...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And every time he produced a sound that I hadn't heard before, I always wanted to learn to do what he just did.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So many things went through my mind while I was composing my very first song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
I have a pretty good idea of what I want to do now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can't help but feel all this nostalgia.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Mafuyu said this song is similar to that other song I composed a while back.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I also thought a lot about Mom and Dad while composing that song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The carnations should be somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
None of them seem to be in bloom.
I guess it's the wrong time of year.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: When Mizuki and I came here that other time, these flower beds all had white carnations in full bloom.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I wish I could see them again...
But I guess there's nothing I can do right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I thought it was you!
I couldn't help but run over to make sure it was really you since it's super duper rare to see you in a place like this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe I should start taking the early shift at work more often from now on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, are you just coming off a shift?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I was just wandering around thinking about what to get for lunch, and that's when I spotted you♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That reminds me.
This is where we saw all those carnations, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I was hoping to see them again...
But now's probably not the right time of the year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, it's a good thing I decided to chase you down because I know a way to make all the flowers here bloom♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Just play along for a bit.
Turn towards the flower beds and close your eyes for me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Mira-Mira-Miracle!
Make the flowers from Kanade's memories... Return!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, since this is one of my favorite spots.
I decided to take a video so that I can look at the flowers after they're all gone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The petals from the other flowers wafting in the breeze were so pretty that I wanted you to see them, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mizuki...
I didn't think I'd get to see these flowers again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
I'm really happy that I finally got to show you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll send it over on Nightcord so you can watch it whenever.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It feels kind of strange to be working together when it's still so bright out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Are we working on the lyrics some more?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm, I think I'll log into Nightcord just in case.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heya♪ You getting some work in too?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, Yuki and I were just going to get started. I didn't realize you'd both be working too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Well, y'know. I was going to make some more progress after we split off yesterday, but I ended up falling asleep...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Same here. But hey, that means I'm working during the day for a nice, well-adjusted day off.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Actually, that sounds like it'll throw off your body clock and affect you tonight or tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <There you go again, always having to rain on someone's parade...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're telling me you don't remember? Just yesterday while we were working...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
A message?
Oh, it's from Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Hello, Kanade. I'm sorry to ask you so suddenly, but is your schedule for the week after next already filled up?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? Did you say something, K? I couldn't hear over Enanan...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, what's that supposed to mean? If you want me to shut up, just say so. It's more annoying when you try to sugarcoat it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha! Don't let her get to you, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's not a big deal. I just got a message from Hoshino asking if I'm free the week after next.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She's in a band with Honami and them, and you taught her how to compose songs before, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, she said the week after next?! That means it's super important!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Huh? Uhh... Is there something going on?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <C'mon, did you forget? Your birthday is the week after next, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Not much of a reaction there! You really should be more excited, it only comes once a year!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Exactly. Ichika must've contacted you because she wants to celebrate your birthday, don't you think?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um, what do I say... I don't have anything going on besides Ms. Mochizuki coming some days, so I guess I'll just be home working...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <If you're okay with it, why not tell her you're free?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's your birthday, so you should give everyone the opportunity to celebrate.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We still don't know it's actually about celebrating her birthday.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <By the way, our party for you is scheduled for the night of your birthday.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And that's in SEKAI, so go ahead and do as you like until nighttime!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello. Thank you for having me again today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Of course! Oh, that's right.
May I have a moment before I get to work?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... Thank you for accepting Ichika's invitation.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
“I'm free the week after next.”
Also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: “For my birthday, I only have plans with the rest of N25 that night, so I'm open until then”... Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't have any plans during the day, and Ena and Mizuki told me to let people celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was actually with Ichika at the time, and she really was so happy...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh! Kanade sent a reply!
She says she's free on her birthday until nighttime!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah! Okay, I think I'll ask to meet around noon.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, first... “Thanks for your reply.”
Next, umm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I know you have a lot going on, so I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh no, don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, but what will you do that day, Mafuyu?
I'll be going out to meet Hoshino around noon...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'll be here.
I want to write more lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And if I don't have anything better to do, I can just go help Mizuki and the others prepare for the birthday party. So, there's no need to worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? Okay, I'll leave you to it then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The day isn't quite here yet, but please do enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to this. It's kind of been a while since I last saw Hoshino.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade.
And thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, thank you.
I know you're busy with your band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's no trouble! You've helped me out so much, and I wanted to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I don't mean to cut right to the chase, but there's a song I'd like you to hear.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A song? I see... That explains why you messaged me this morning saying to bring my earbuds.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes...
It's a birthday song I made just for today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Okay, I'll give it a listen.

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Happy birthday to you♪ Happy birthday to you♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Miku's voice feels so warm and kind... This tuning is very well done.)

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, dear Kanade♪ Happy birthday to you♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Happy birthday to you♪ Happy birthday to you♪>

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Nene's Voices
rows.Line: <La la laa laa laa laa♪ La la la laa laa laa♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (These backing vocals... Is this Hoshino and Kusanagi?)

rows.Speaker: Minori & Honami's Voices
rows.Line: <La la laa laa laa laa♪ La la la laa laa laa♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And now it's Ms. Mochizuki and Hanasato...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Wait, now there's guitar and the hi-hat of the drums.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I see. The song must be about to really start. This is exciting.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thanks, Hoshino.
I listened to the end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you. So... How was it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For the part at the beginning with just Miku singing, the tuning was so well done, and I could feel so much warmth and kindness in her voice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But then I realized that was just the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The band arrangement that came in once Kusanagi and the others joined in was also really good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The warm and kind feeling of it remained, but the song started to pick up and felt more lively as different instruments started coming in.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The melody of the birthday song repeated throughout, but I never got bored listening to it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I decided to try making an arrangement with the help of my bandmates.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, you might have recognized their voices, but I got Honami, Kusanagi and Minori to sing as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. I knew it already, but you all really are good singers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And it was satisfying to hear the way your voices overlapped...
That being said, it didn't sound like you did much in the way of mixing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wow...!
I didn't think you'd pick up on that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. Everyone's recordings turned out really well, for one thing, and I also thought using them as they were would lend the song more warmth.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. We included some castanets and a recorder too, and for those, I asked Kusanagi and Minori to help...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry!
I didn't mean to talk so much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No worries.
I want to hear how the song was made.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
