rows.Line: Oh, and since we're talking about it, I'd like to hear what made you decide to make it as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here you are.
Two servings of Ms. Yoisaki's birthday “special plate”.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Salisbury steak, spaghetti and gratin.
There's fried shrimp and pudding too... This is a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes... We're really living the life of luxury.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Your birthday only comes once a year, after all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade!
Actually, I really wanted to say it in person...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But since I can't be there because of work, I made sure to put all my birthday wishes into Ichika's song!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, I hope you enjoy it. Have a great birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was thinking I'd like to celebrate somehow since we got to know each other and all, and that's when Hoshino asked me for help with her song...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope you could feel some of my birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Isn't it great that she liked the song, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, I thought making a song would be the best way to show that everything she taught me is helping me out. I'm glad I did it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I enjoyed being able to help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I wish you a very happy birthday, Ms. Yoisaki.
I'll continue coming by to cook delicious meals for you, so please look forward to them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heya, Kanade!
Sounds like you've had a fun birthday. I'm glad♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: As for us, it was nice that we were able to take it easy getting ready for tonight's party.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Take it easy? You forgot several things we needed, so we kept coming and going...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's just how we are, so it's all part of the package♪
Besides, we want to celebrate, and that's what's important!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, let's finish this off together.
One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu, Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade.
Happy birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Everyone gave me so much warmth today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to hold on to these feelings and keep doing my best this year.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: I think so. Minori just messaged me saying that their group just finished doing their meeting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Kanade, Ichika, welcome!
We were just getting ready for our practice tea party.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Umm... Hanasato? Momoi?
Thank you both for finding a place where we can practice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'll do better than I've done in the past, but I'm starting to wonder if I'll be able to prepare our tea properly during the actual thing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, since we'll be at a park, we won't be using quite the same things as here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, let's just do our best today to simulate the real thing!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (My initial hope was that they'd just give us a little advice, but they've gone out of their way to put together a practice tea party...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That means I need to do what I can to learn how to prepare the best tea I can.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we're all set to go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, the water's boiling, so we can start steeping the tea.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll give it a try this time as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How's the teapot...? Okay, it should be warm enough.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just put in enough tea leaves for one person for this taste test.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, we'll need to make the most of the water in our kettle during the day of, so we should see how our tea turns out after the hot water's cooled down a bit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, enough tea leaves for one person...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'll need to steep yours for two minutes, Kanade, and mine needs four, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? I didn't realize each type of tea had to be steeped for a different amount of time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it apparently depends on the size and length of the leaves.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade's tea leaves don't take very long to steep because they're so thin. Mine are much bigger, which means steeping them for longer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me, I've heard that it's much better to use glass teapots like this one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, because they allow you to see how the color of the water changes and the way the leaves are moving.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The way they're moving...? Oh, they're spinning around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. The tea leaves “jump” because of convection.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've heard that before!
The tea's supposed to taste better after they've spun around a lot, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Go, go, tea leaves!
MORE MORE JUMPING!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, not so close to the table!
You don't wanna ruin the groove by shaking it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It smells nice...
But it tastes a little bitter...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try using less of the leaves or not steeping it for as long?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
We can just keep making adjustments like that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Can you tell me what you think of this herbal tea?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, it smells so nice and fresh...!
This aroma makes me feel really healthy for some reason!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And it tastes great!
You can definitely stick to whatever you just did.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Momoi, Hanasato...
Thank you for tasting everything for us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We feel much better about our tea party now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's make this tea party a great one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, as much as I hate to say this, it's time to start cleaning everything up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... I bought some cookies to go with our tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'd completely forgotten about them until now because I was so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, let's have them now!
We still have a bit of tea left.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can we, Kanade? I was actually just starting to get a little hungry!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Would you like some as well, Hoshino...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mmm... Tea and sweets. What more can you ask for?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm so glad we got a chance to practice for our tea party.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And I want to do my best for everyone when this happens for real.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, I tried changing the feel of the intro a bit. Would you mind listening to it for me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I made some tea but left the cups and teapot out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's okay.
I can wash them and put them away for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I was wondering what that nice fragrance was. So you made a herbal tea?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I had some leaves left over from the party.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, but Mafuyu was the one who made it today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's the least I could do since you put on the party.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, you don't have to repay me for—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, you still worried me when I was watching you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I feel like I can do it on my own now after practicing so much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Especially compared to when you first tried making tea. You were wandering around with cups and a teapot in your hands.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... How does Ms. Mochizuki usually prepare tea?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Start by putting a kettle on...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, I think she warms up the cups with hot water... That means I have to boil some water first and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, why don't you put those cups down for now? You might drop them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, when I tried to make tea with Ms. Mochizuki, I ended up putting in too many tea leaves because I wasn't sure what the right amount was. And the tea turned out so strong.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? This looks darker compared to when you make this, Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait... I can balance that out with a little more water...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
M-Ms. Yoisaki!
Why don't we have some milk tea this time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Milk goes very well with Earl Grey, so I recommend diluting the tea with that instead of hot water.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought the tea we had that time was very good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness you suggested that we should have milk tea instead, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I also found a website that mentioned how you should use milk for certain types of tea and hot water for others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It sounds like you did quite a lot of research in preparation for our tea party...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you again for inviting me to it.
I had a wonderful time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And the tea you made was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad you had such a good time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That reminds me... I had some of that tea from the party with my family.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My mom enjoyed it so much that she ended up making more for me and herself this morning.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really! She even talked about adding in some cinnamon and trying a couple of other variations.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (My initial hope was that everyone would have a somewhat enjoyable time at our party...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I wasn't expecting it to have such a lasting effect like this.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And Mafuyu also seemed to enjoy herself.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So I'm glad we decided to hold that tea party.)
Kanade, shouldn't you get up soon?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Mafuyu...? What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I knocked, but you didn't answer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We're going to Ena's dad's exhibit today...!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry! I'll get up now...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Did you stay up all night working again...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-Yes. I was trying to find a good place to stop, but I sort of lost track of time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
Just give me a second to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry about making you help me get ready. I didn't realize my hair was such a mess...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. I'm just glad we were able to fix it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You did all the work, Mafuyu.
I can't really see the back of my head, so thank you for straightening it all out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We ended up leaving the house a little late, but I'm glad that it looks like we'll still be able to meet up with Mizuki on time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm guessing it worked out since we planned to get there a bit early.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I had to get ready in a hurry.
I hope I didn't forget to bring anything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You should be fine as long as you have the essentials, like your phone and wallet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Good point.
Let's see... My phone and wallet are...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I remember being a little surprised when I first heard that her dad's a famous artist. I mean, I immediately recognized his name...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you ever seen any of his works before, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Just a few.
My mom's a fan of his.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She doesn't seem too bothered by that...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We need to take a right up here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Ena also stayed up late working last night. I hope she was able to get up this morning.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I just hope she didn't oversleep like you did, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, it's been so long since I last went to an art exhibit. And this one's by Ena's dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I started working on a new song in order to turn what I felt when I saw Ena's dad's art into music...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm having so much trouble capturing it in sound...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What was that painting named again...? “A Peony Blooming in the Night”...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, we're pretty far in now.
The next painting is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This painting resonates with me so much more than the other ones for some reason. But why...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (His other paintings all involved darkness in some way, and they seemed to be an expression of his pain and suffering. But this one...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to try putting this sensation into a song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I even bought a book of his paintings to make sure that I don't forget what I felt that time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But that painting still stands above the rest for me.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know what Ena's dad felt when he made that painting...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to turn what I felt into a song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
(I feel like it captures what I felt that time.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's already morning. Did you stay up all night working...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Huh? Oh, you're right.
I didn't realize that it was morning already.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Geez... Promise me that you'll at least take a nap later, okay? At the same time, I'm one to talk...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. After I logged off yesterday, I noticed something about my illustration that I didn't like. I was fixing that until now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Anyway, I was about the send my file over, and I saw that you were online. That really took me by surprise.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Wait, only Ena and I are here right now. This could be my chance to...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, there's a song that I'd like for you to listen to...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, you already composed another song...?! You work way too fast!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, but it's not for N25.
It's something that I just felt like composing is all...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, would you mind listening to it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay. I do want to hear what it's like, so I'll give it a listen...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you. I'll send it over now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <For starters, it felt a little different from the songs you usually compose...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<A little different...?
Can you elaborate on that?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... The songs you compose for N25 usually involve seeing the light at the end of a long, dark tunnel so to speak. But with this song...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<The light took center stage...
It felt like something incredibly precious that you couldn't go on without. Like it meant everything.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Something that I can't go on without...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also, why did you want me to listen to it?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, so...
I based this song on what I felt when I saw one of your dad's paintings.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It was the painting called “A Peony Blooming in the Night”... Something about it felt special.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I didn't realize that painting would turn into this kind of song...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That exhibit was definitely worth the trip.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Not only did I get to see all those paintings, but I was also able to compose a kind of song that I usually don't...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still don't know what Ena's dad was feeling when he painted that peony...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I hope that my song was able to do it some justice.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... They all should be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for asking you all to join me here on short notice. I know we're supposed to start working soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, that's totally fine!
We've all been looking forward to hearing the demo for the next song♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Kanade, is Mafuyu not with you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
About that...
She isn't feeling all that well...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... She didn't seem to be running a fever, so I think she'll be fine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But she did look really pale.
I told her to get some rest just in case.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you think she'll be able to sleep?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Good question...
It can be hard when you're feeling under the weather.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was with her until she lay down, and I went back to my own room after that to give her some privacy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm hoping that she'll be able to get some sleep...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would it be okay for me to go see her, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm worried about Mafuyu...
I'll be careful not to wake her if she's asleep.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you're going, Miku, then I wanna go too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, if you two don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd feel a lot better knowing that you two are with her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, but not as many people will get to listen to your demo...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I asked Luka and Len to also join us, so they should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, Miku, Rin, Mafuyu's in your hands!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Please let us know if anything happens.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess we can breathe a sigh of relief for now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I hope Mafuyu can get some rest...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello.
Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is Asahina not back yet...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, she said she has club today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, but she did say that it's okay for you to clean like you normally do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll get started like normal.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of cleaning, would it be alright if I sorted the cabinet with all the tea?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's starting to get pretty full.
To be fair, it's my fault for bringing over so much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, there is a lot in here now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Understood.
I'll do my best to make things easy to find.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The lyrics Mafuyu wrote are very good. I should make sure the music is more reflective of...)

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Dinner's just about ready, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, okay. I'll be right there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu...
I didn't realize you were back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here you are, Ms. Yoisaki.
I made teriyaki tofu steaks today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mmm... This is good.
And it's not too rich. I really like it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad you're enjoying it so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
I've also finished sorting out the tea cabinet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh wow...
These tins were so cluttered. Now they're completely organized.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I initially began by transferring the tea leaves that were running low into their own zipper bags.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I placed the ones that should be used first in the front and the unopened tins a little towards the back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The ones further back are in a case with a handle on it, so they should be easy to retrieve. Please let me know if you have any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I saw this lavender-flavored tea that I didn't recognize. Did you and Asahina buy it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's the tea my dad brought over.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's so nice of him. Then, I'm glad I decided to put it towards the front since it seemed special and like it had just been opened.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. We really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I'm amazed by how you could tell that it was special.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. As I just mentioned, I didn't recognize it, and it's from a famous shop.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Does your dad know quite a lot about teas, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
He likes to drink tea...
But I don't think he knows much about who makes what.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, he may've done a bit of research before actually going over to this shop.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's supposed to be quite soothing, so I hope you get a chance to drink it during breaks and such.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (He looked at Mafuyu so tenderly that time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ms. Mochizuki may be right. He probably put a lot of thought into that tea. For his daughter's sake.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...
We should try to savor every drop of that tea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...
Thank you, Kanade. For letting us listen to your song.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I-It was so good...
My chest feels tight, but it puts me at peace at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was able to make it into something I'm happy with thanks to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I mentioned this back when I played you the demo, but things just weren't clicking before.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then I heard all of your thoughts, which helped me pinpoint the parts that felt off to me and fix them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It was completely different from before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
I suppose so, since I changed the melody.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, you sure threw us for a loop with that. Still, I'm really glad it worked out!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We'd already made a lot of progress on the lyrics and illustrations at that point.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I really wanted to incorporate their ideas.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it. I mean, it made for a better song.
Right, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think this new melody does a better job of conveying the song's message.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll be on my way too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I will too, then.
Please do drop by again anytime.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought I heard a child's voice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
I'm pretty sure I stopped playing Untitled, so why am I still in SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, something's glowing by the lake...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Here it is... This reminds me of that ball of light I picked up before... The fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But this is much smaller, and it's shaped like a shard that broke off of something...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
How strange.
That child's voice... Was it just my imagination...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, that was a child's voice.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So you heard it too, KAITO.
I think it was coming from the direction of...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Is that... Kanade?
I thought she went back...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
...!
Was that... A fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, something seems off... What could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling things are about to get interesting.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't even touch that glowing shard, so why am I in some strange place again...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's the same voice I heard a minute ago... Still, there's something nostalgic about it. I wonder why...)

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: I've been waiting so, so long...

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line:
Ack...
If all these flashes keep happening, I'm going to lose my eyesight...

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line: I thought I heard Luka and KAITO, but what's going on now...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line: Oh... So you two are here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line: That's a relief. I suddenly ended up in this strange place, so I was trying to figure out what to do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: From the way you're talking, it sounds like you're the same on the inside...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Tell me, Kanade.
While you're talking to us like this, doesn't something feel a little off?

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line:
...
Now that you mention it, my voice sounds kind of...high-pitched...

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line: Huh? Were you two always this tall?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Figure it out already. You're the one who's shrunk.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, you thought you heard a child's voice, and then found a glowing shard by the lake...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right... I made sure not to touch it, but it suddenly flashed, and before I knew it I was here...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You were talking to a smaller version of yourself when we arrived.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: I've been waiting so, so long...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That girl had somewhat of a strange air to her...
It felt like she was you, but not.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
...
Whoever she is, there's no mistake that she knows this SEKAI's secrets.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, what about you two? What brought you here...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We also heard the girl's voice, and were looking for the source. That was when we saw you by the lake...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We went after you when you got pulled into this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for being here. If it were just me, I don't think I'd ever figure out what to do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, it's nice to hear we have your confidence.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But this is all new to us as well, so we don't know what to do either.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, but don't you think that's better than panicking?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We're lacking information.
Let's have a look around.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I suppose.
Okay, Kanade. Let's hold hands so you don't get lost.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait, pictures of me?
What are they doing here, and so many...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm sure this is related to the place we're in somehow.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Was this one taken at one of your after-parties with the others?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, we're at that diner, so I think so.
Oh, and this one's from the tea party we had last White Day...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It looks like a birthday photo.
Hehe, little Kanade's trying her hardest to blow out the candles on her cake.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Okay, can you blow out all the candles?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Ah, wait! The camera, let me get the camera!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
*Blow*
*Blow*
Aww, the candles won't go out...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha. Try taking a deep, deep breath and blowing as hard as you can.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you recall ever telling anyone about the moment in this photo, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think I have. Until recently, I've kept myself from remembering any of the time I spent with my family...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think that's why for a lot of these photos, I can't recall the moment they were taken, even when I'm looking at them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We are talking about when you were very little. It's quite possible you've simply forgotten because of how long it's...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think I understand what that other little Kanade meant when she said “Don't forget again.”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And the nature of this SEKAI too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This SEKAI...
It was born from your feelings, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If there were only photos of your family, it could possibly have been your dad's feelings... But Mafuyu and the others are here as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
But what feeling of mine would do this...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What you said a minute ago is essentially the answer.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whether they've been whittled down or shattered, the feelings that form this place have lost their true shape.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In all likelihood, that happened because you thought you didn't deserve to wish, and constantly kept them buried.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know you feel awful about what happened to your dad, but there's no point in beating yourself up...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What I'm trying to say is... I think your happiness is a separate issue.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I still can't do what you were able to, Dad, but there is someone who really needs my songs now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because if I can do that... If I can make others happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hope you pat my head...
And praise me for not giving up all this time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Even for just a moment...
If it means regaining...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. I'll keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
Oh, but what happened to that shard of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It returned to you when that SEKAI dissipated.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But why were my feelings here...?
This is Mafuyu's SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If I had to guess, maybe they were able to take shape by leaning on the power of this SEKAI's feelings?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All in the hopes that you would take notice of them before they disappeared forever...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's also possible that you yourself didn't want to lose them, and your self-defense mechanisms kicked in to prevent that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't want to lose them...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll say this. What becomes of that shard from now on is up to you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you end up suppressing your feelings again...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right, I'll make sure to be careful of that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: After all, you and Ena...so many people helped me remember them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... Quite a lot happened today.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
I didn't mean to cause you two so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But I'm always having trouble, and making weird sounds. Because of that, I end up getting left out of performances...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I got so jealous...And frustrated. I started wondering why I'm so bad and they're so good...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If keeping a steady tone would be enough, I may be able to teach you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If any part of you still wishes to produce beautiful music, then I implore you to not give up here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because you will be able to... Someday.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (To me, the performance Dad put on for us that day falls into that category.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Figuring out how to produce sounds the way he wanted wasn't easy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm so glad that he didn't give up on playing the trumpet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And he seemed so relieved by the time we said goodbye to each other.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Like he'd found something he'd lost, and been searching ages for...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel a good melody coming together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This might be a bit too cheerful to be used for an N25 song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But it still sort of fits us as a group. It might even help me with our next song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, this sounds too pop...
I should probably lower the tempo a little, and the overall tone...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It doesn't need to sound hip or trendy. I want it to feel pure, a bit juvenile and capture a hint of uncertainty. Also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, what should we do for dinner?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's coming along pretty well, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This song's a bit more invigorating than our usual ones.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But it's enough for a rough demo, so I think I'll stop here for now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? You made dinner all by yourself, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You were so focused on what you were doing that you didn't hear anything I said earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... I'm sorry for not noticing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Were you working on our next song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No. Remember the boy we met today?
I was composing a song based on him.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Would you like to hear it?
Here, use my headphones.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A good melody sort of started coming together in my head, so I worked on it a little. Unfortunately, we probably won't be able to use it for an N25 song.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's like he was able to find the light he'd been searching for, and he's embracing it tightly so as to not lose it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If that's what you heard, Mafuyu, then I guess that means I was able to turn my mental image into music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Having that mental image is so vital...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I doubt I would've been able to come up with this melody if that boy hadn't smiled the way he did at the end before we left.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for showing this to me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, also, you said that dinner's ready...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I heated up some of that braised fish.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. Then, let's go eat.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Our after-party this time around was really fun♪ Especially because they were having that cake fair. We got to try so many different types!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Their mini cake platter was pretty incredible. Each one was only bite-sized, but they were stacked into a pyramid.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah! It was super photogenic, so I'm really glad we took the dive and ordered it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
There's a crowd gathered over there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're right. I also thought I heard someone ring a bell just now.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: We're holding a drawing to celebrate our grand reopening! Show us your receipt and you'll receive a number of attempts based on the total!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. That building was under construction for a really long time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it used to be mostly restaurants and stuff. But now, it looks like it's all apparel shops.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, do those receipt lotteries usually draw that big a crowd?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not sure, but you two won your tickets for Shibuya Instrument Day through one of these, right, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, but we didn't go shopping with it in mind. We just happened to come across it on our way out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I mean, that's pretty normal.
Unless they have something really good up for grabs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why'd you start running like that all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Take a look at what the second-place prize is!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Let's see...
A pair of tickets to have the full course at Eden Fruit Parlor?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My mom and I talked about how great it'd be to go here even just once in our lives.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Their full course is so popular that they're always booked up a year in advance.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Oh, are you interested in the tickets to Eden?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: The winner of these will be allowed to make a special reservation during the next three months.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Weren't you just saying that these drawings don't do a good job of attracting customers?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, since we're here, why don't we have a look around? I gotta work off all the cake I just ate.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, we get it.
You wanna buy enough stuff to get a chance at those tickets, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't mind either way.
But the odds of you winning those tickets are low.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't rain on my parade before it's had a chance to even begin!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Seriously...
Just you wait! I'm gonna win them!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Okay, based on the total on your receipt, you qualify for two attempts!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Alright, we have...!
White! The consolation prize, a coupon for one of our shops!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that this is their last day, but that doesn't make it any easier to win their second prize.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But she still has one attempt left.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You won those tickets to Shibuya Instrument Day, right, Kanade? Gimme a hand here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wanna win those tickets, so share some of your luck with me, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Share some of her luck with you?
Life would be a lot nicer if all it took to share good luck was holding hands.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just shut up and watch, will you?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Okay, please make your final spin.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The blue ball is the one for second prize.)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Congratulations!
You've won our second-place prize! A pair of tickets to have the full course at Eden Fruit Parlor!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, Kanade, the next time I enter into a ticket lottery for an event, you gotta let me hold your hand.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
Now I can go like I've been dreaming!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know how much I actually helped, but congratulations, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Are you kidding? You played a huge role.
In return, I'm gonna bring back lots of treats for you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll be looking forward to seeing what you bring back. I hope you enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Those people must be the ones who watch it immediately after receiving an upload notification.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I guess there really are people waiting for us to release new videos.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I know it's a little early, but why don't we call things here today since there doesn't seem to be anything wrong with the upload.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay! So, what's our next song gonna be like?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, I'm still working on the demo for it. Please feel free to take tomorrow and the day after off if you like.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <In other words, it'll be ready the day after tomorrow♪ I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me neither. In the meantime, I guess I'll try working on some personal stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, please do.
I'll let you know if anything comes up.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
Thank you for all your hard work, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Are you going to keep working after this, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, since I'd like to have a rough demo done tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu seems really at ease whenever we're all working together. So, I should probably try to finish this as soon as I can...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If I can have this ready by tomorrow afternoon, the others can listen to it and...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, umm... I was thinking about our next song, but I feel like I'm forgetting something.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, yes. That might be it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess I forgot since Mizuki or Ena are the ones who usually bring it up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, it is a little strange how neither of them have brought it up yet.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sure they're busy, since there's less than one week left before Kamiyama High's school festival...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I also forgot about that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... What should we do about our after-party...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We can throw one or not. I don't mind either way...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But they both seem to still be on Nightcord, so why not try asking them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd rather not have them come back and ask, “Why didn't either of you say anything?”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They are always looking forward to our after-parties.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, but we forgot to talk about our after-party. What should we do?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now we just need to wait for them to respond...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think they're back on call, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right...
Let's see... Where'd the call button go...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Enanan? Amia?
Sorry for making you two come back.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No, I'm also sorry.
I totally forgot about our after-party because I've been so busy with my assignments for art class.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And I forgot because of the school festival.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<That's less than one week away, yes?
If you're both too busy, then we don't have to throw one...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, we have to throw one! It's one of the few times we get to talk in person!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha! See how fast she jumped on that?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I agree. I wanna throw one too, especially since K doesn't get out much otherwise.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't think that should be much of a consideration... But anyway, we'll be throwing an after-party as always.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Still, it's getting pretty late.
Why don't we pick this up again when we're listening to the new demo?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you. Anyway, we'll see you later.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
I fear that I'm going to forget about our after-party while working on this demo.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll remind you about it if you do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'd really appreciate that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to get working on our new song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(For Mafuyu's sake...
And for the sake of everyone who looks forward to our videos.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We need to start heading over to Class 3-C soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. We'll want good seats for Tsukasa and his class's show, so let's go now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Would that be alright, Kanade, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I was really impressed by what Kusanagi and her class did...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really were able to try on all the costumes and outfits you wanted.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Some people decided to dress as hot dogs and bowling pins while we were there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, those...
I never would've tried them on since they looked totally ludicrous.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But they also had some really photogenic cosplay outfits. Like the twelve-layered kimono you tried on, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really startled me when you first asked if I wanted to try it on, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
At first glance, it looked gorgeous enough to be the real deal.
But it was just designed to look like there were twelve layers, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Exactly!
It's also super easy to change into thanks to the magic of hook-and-loop fasteners♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I knew you'd look amazing in it, Kanade, since you have such long hair. I've gotta give myself a pat on the back for this one!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know it was a cosplay outfit, but it still looked fairly heavy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It was...
Once I had it on, I couldn't really move freely.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel like you were barely able to stay standing. I remember your legs wobbling a bit while we were taking pictures.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If a cosplay outfit is that heavy, then I can't even begin to imagine what people back then had to endure.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That reminds me, didn't Mizuki find a dress for you to wear too, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, the long dress with an Asian feel to it? I was asked to try it on, so I did...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And that wasn't a cosplay outfit.
It was a real-life party gown.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But despite the high-class and grown-up aura it exuded, you totally pulled it off, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, Kusanagi and the others also seemed stunned when they saw you in it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel like they were exaggerating...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, what did you all think of that traditional maid dress I wore? It was cute, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that did look really good on you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But it also feels like cheating, you know?
It sorta didn't feel natural.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So what?
I thought the whole point was to dress up and have fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You might've had the most fun out of all of us, Ena. You even had Mizuki take all those pictures of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't get me started.
Taking shots from all those angles wasn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't forget that we all wore those weird dinosaur costumes afterwards like you asked.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, we all dressed up as T-Rexes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They were relatively easy to put on.
All you had to do was step in, zip up the back and inflate it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But is there a reason you wanted us to wear those, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well... Obviously, because I thought all four of us wearing them would make for a really stunning pic.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Plus, I kinda doubt we'll ever find another chance to do that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Kanade, your T-Rex was shorter than ours for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Weren't we all given adult-sized costumes initially?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... Remember the window in the chest that allowed the wearer to see out of it...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My face could only reach about halfway up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, and it would've been a shame if we couldn't really see her face in the picture.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I figured the children's version would fit better and asked her to try that on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Unfortunately, the hole for that one was too low, so I had to hunch over...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I never imagined myself going to a school festival with other people.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Everyone seems to be enjoying themselves, so it could be fun to do more things like this every now and again...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I think we all know where we'll be looking tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, here...
It's this sewing lounge.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You'd probably pass through Main Street to get there from the station, so I should keep an eye out for Mizuki on my way over...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've finished doing my homework, so I'm free to work now. What are your plans...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I just found where I'll be going tomorrow, so I think I'll start working too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I was wondering what Mizuki is doing right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Between having to deal with supplementary classes and such, nothing seemed all that strange when we got that message saying, “I won't be able to work for a while”...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was under the same impression initially.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But Ena's also been acting a little strange lately.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. In hindsight, there were a lot of clues that I could've picked up on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It would've been nice to see this as a music video, but Amia seems very busy. We'll just have to go with a still frame this time around...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Still, it's strange to not see or hear from Amia for so long. We talk almost every day, so things feel a little emptier than usual.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It sounded like you were trying to say something just now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ena's probably been trying to figure out what to do since that time.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, when did you notice that Ena was acting a little strange...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When the three of us were working on that song we uploaded the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Despite not being muted, she was eerily quiet. And she never gave us any concrete responses to our questions...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At first, I thought she hadn't been getting enough sleep.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, since that's happened a few times before.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But Ena doesn't usually hide what she's feeling in those situations.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I think I know what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And yet, when she was working on the illustration for our last song, she was quiet for most of the time. Especially after Mizuki stopped joining us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which is why I didn't think it had anything to do with Ena not getting enough sleep or anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought something else probably happened.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this, you two...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ena didn't tell us what happened between her and Mizuki, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Based on the expression we saw on Ena's face, it must be very serious.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We need to find Mizuki, tell Ena and give them a chance to talk.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You said they're around here, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Looks like they finally had a chance to talk.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we should give them some space for now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: MEIKO, would you mind being with them for a little while longer?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku and the others are probably worried, so we can go over to SEKAI to tell them what's happening. We'll be waiting for you over there.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They'll be here in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's been so long since we last saw Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...
So, um... What are we allowed to say?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
About that...
First, I'd like for us to hear what Mizuki has to say.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have a feeling it's very important.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell all of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something you guys have to hear...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something I've been wanting to say.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not telling you guys until now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I should've done this sooner. I was meaning to...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. It's also our fault for not realizing how much this was weighing on you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, it's all my fault for not saying anything...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No matter what happens, in our eyes, you're you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, thank you for being so brave.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And thank you for telling us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm also glad that you told us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
See?
Didn't I say that it'd all work out in the end?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Again, it's wonderful to have you back with us like this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And don't hesitate to ask us for help in the future if you ever need it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're a valued member of N25.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So if something is causing you trouble or to suffer, then we want to be there for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because it hurts us too when it feels like there's nothing we can do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, please don't be afraid to tell us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I look forward to having you around again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... That company's website should be... Oh, here it is.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh, they even have products exclusive to the online store.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I probably never would've thought to buy clothes from an outdoors retailer if Tenma hadn't suggested it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Aside from clothes, they have a wide selection of accessories and outdoor goods. Sleeping bags, portable lamps...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm seeing so many new things since I don't normally look at these kinds of sites...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What do you want to do about dinner...?
I can heat some food up for you if you're hungry.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's already time for dinner...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I am feeling hungry.
I'll lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's the website for a famous outdoor goods company.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
No, I don't plan on going camping.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Tenma told me about this company the other day is all...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I decided to take a look at what other products they have, and got a bit carried away.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I never realized how impressive outdoor products are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not only are they durable, they're also incredibly well designed. For example, these shoes...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: These shoes? They look like hiking boots...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's supposed to be very easy to tackle trails in the mountains with them because the soles are so sturdy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which made me think that I wouldn't become as tired if I wore a pair of these whenever I went out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're usually in an urban environment, Kanade, so I'm not sure these would help...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, because how thick the soles of your shoes need to be will change depending on whether you're walking paved roads or a rocky trail.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If anything, boots this sturdy may end up feeling really heavy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, if you're curious, you could try a pair on at one of their shops. They may even carry some lighter shoes that you find more comfortable to walk in.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it might be good to go...
Especially if a new pair will make my walks easier...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, this hat also caught my eye.
It's apparently called a “safari hat”...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Explorers in movies always have these on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought it'd be nice to have one of these handy for those really sunny days.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it has a wide brim, so it probably is good at blocking the sun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Oh, this backpack also seemed useful...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Now it sounds like you're going mountain climbing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose it would seem that way.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know... At the very least, you'd stand out while walking around the city.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... But these all seem handy and comfortable...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess I wouldn't mind standing out a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you're comfortable with that, then you should get them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I thought they were very good.
Especially the ones you drew for the chorus.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I really liked the way the characters' clothes seemed to waft as a breeze blew by. They felt so free.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Congratulations, Enanan♪
I know you worked super hard on getting that right.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. This song has a more pleasant feel to it compared to normal, so I wanted to capture that somehow.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I even did a ton of research.
I went through my own wardrobe and used the pictures I found in some magazines as reference.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You went so deep that you ended up going to buy that one really cute outfit you saw in a magazine, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, but that still counts as research.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Speaking of clothes, that reminds me...
Didn't you say that you did some modeling the other day, K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, are you talking about Tenma's project?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, that! That seemed to take up a lot of your time. How'd things go in the end?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, what was it like being a model?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Umm... Initially, I was worried that I wouldn't be able to do a good job...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But it ended up being a nice learning experience.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, like how things are presented and expressed in the world of fashion.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Gaining that sort of new knowledge made the whole process very intriguing.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, does that mean you've finally started to see why fashion is so awesome?♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Umm... I'm not so sure about that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I guess that's natural knowing you, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, I wish I went over to see your shoot. I really wanna know what it was like.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heh heh heh! Yeah, of course you do! I bet you're super curious!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, what was that? You know something, don't you...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <See, I helped with their outfits, so Saki showed me the finished product.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What? Why'd you also get to see, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Tenma sent me the picture she took.
Would you like to see it, Enanan...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Would I like to see it? Show me! Right now!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know, right? She looks so grown-up, but also really cute at the same time!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah... This strikes such a stunning balance.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You look so delicate...
And this hairstyle suits you really well, K...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, Tenma worked really hard on everything...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The fashion styling is one thing, but it feels like a lot of work went into the photography too...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, yes. Azusawa actually gave us a few tips and tricks regarding how to take good portraits.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, that explains the composition being basically perfect. It even includes just the right amount of light.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, K, how would you feel dressing up like this and going somewhere together?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, we should totally do that! It'll be so much fun!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't know how to give myself a fancy hairdo, and Tenma provided all the clothes...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No problem! I'll do your hair for you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<And I'll lend you my clothes!
I actually have just the thing for you♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That reminds me of this hairstyle I saw in a magazine the other day. I bet it'd look amazing on you, K!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <This seems like the perfect opportunity to give it a try! What do you say, K?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, what's it like? Send me a pic!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks for listening to the demo, everyone. I'll make sure to keep your feedback in mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm looking forward to the finished song.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What, already? But we've barely had a chance to talk to Miku and everyone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna chat some more first!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't mind, but what do you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: About... Lots of things! Right, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't have anything specific in mind...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... I have something I want to ask you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Your birthday is coming up.
I was wondering what you'll do to celebrate...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't have any plans right now. It's a whole two weeks from now, after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Mizuki, Mafuyu. Why don't we talk about that thing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, we were looking around for a place to hold your birthday party, and we found a cafe that looks great.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The cafe serves a special cake, and if you tell them it's for a birthday, they add on some extras.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They've even been featured on TV, and it's great how they make every single cake to order!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, let's have a party there! We should still be able to make a reservation, too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You three were doing all that for me? I didn't even realize.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That sounds great, then. Let's do it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We're going to throw you a great party!
Look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you both so much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't expect anyone to already be planning things. It's two whole weeks away, after all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! How do you think we feel on the planning side? It's more like, “we only have two weeks left!”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you all been working on this for a while, then?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... We started looking for a place once things calmed down after New Year's, so it's been...about a month?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's right. Though at that point it was just scrolling through restaurant review sites during downtime...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So it's been a while, but it wasn't all that much actual work.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe you thought that far in advance.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course we did. You're our friend, and this is your birthday we're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You only get one a year. We gotta make sure there's no regrets later♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade... Please come visit SEKAI on your birthday too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because, um... We also want to celebrate with you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Got it. We'll all come by.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's still some time before it happens, but I hope you enjoy your party with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you all for coming. Especially since I know you're using your days off for this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It would've been nice to celebrate on your actual birthday, but we wouldn't have had time to hang out, with school and all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: School, that thing you're always so concerned with?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, where's the cafe we're going to?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's closer to Miyamasuzaka, so over that wa—
Oh, there they are! Quick, hurry!
Hey, be more careful! What if she sees us?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't get a good look, but I could have sworn I know them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh, really? I didn't notice anything at all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. If it was someone you knew, Kanade, you'd have recognized them straight away...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, maybe... I guess I imagined it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
The light's turning green.
We don't have a lot of time before our reservation.
That was close. I thought she wouldn't notice us with all the people around...
It's okay, I don't think she realized. Come on, let's hurry after them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So this is the cafe you found?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. It's a bit sunny, but the vibe is super relaxed. It's got a nice atmosphere to it, see?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the staff wear super cute uniforms♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll be shocked, Kanade, so you'd better get ready!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hello there!
I have a table reserved under Akiyama♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you for your reservation! Welcome to carino/carina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That Tenma is here, not at how cute the uniforms are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Tenma, what are you doing here?
Oh, yeah... I remember you said you work at a cafe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehehe, that's right.
This very cafe, as you can see♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Allow me to show you to your table!
Some of your party have already arrived♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Kanade! It's been a while!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena and Mizuki told us about your birthday party, and we jumped at the chance to tag along!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see... Thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So you guys invited other people? I assumed it was just going to be us four, like one of our after-parties.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. So, the real reason we started planning a month in advance was so we could invite everyone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, finding a gap in everyone's schedules was tough, but it was worth the work to get a whole bunch of people to join!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade! Hello there. What a coincidence, meeting you here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... Sorry, we actually just got done with the whole reveal...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Oh, I see! That's actually a relief. I didn't have much faith in my acting ability...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Does that mean you're here to see me, too?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes! Asahina reached out to us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for the kind invitation, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're very welcome. I figured you two would want to give your birthday wishes to her in person.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, if you take your seats I'll get your drink orders in! Then it'll be time for cake!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can hardly believe so many people are here for my birthday...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In truth, we almost had three more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shiraishi and Aoyagi, plus Azusawa. But they're on their trip to the United States with Ena's brother.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's too bad, huh? Still, they said they wanted to give you their well-wishes, so they'll probably message you soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait! Here's our specialty cake... Birthday edition!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's right! They're special celebratory sparklers♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, our specialty cake is already bigger than the other cakes we sell, but...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Would you believe it? The birthday edition has 1.5 times as much frosting and fruit as an extra bonus!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look at that! It reminds me of a certain Mount Everest.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade. It's time to blow out the candles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Blow*
Wait, the ones at the back didn't go out...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've had people celebrate my birthday before, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go and have them cut the cake!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ah... You're on the clock, Tenma. Does that mean you can't have cake with us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: About that... I sure can! Everyone made sure the party timing lined up with the end of my shift.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Once I get the cake cut, I'll clock out, change out of my uniform, and come right back♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that's good...
Thanks for doing all this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Think nothing of it! I'm really happy I was able to help with the party!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And our cake is super delish, so make sure you have a lot!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I never thought it could be so lively.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama seemed quite excited for it, so I'm sure you've had a wonderful birthday already. Please let us extend our best wishes, as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's too bad we couldn't be there for the party, but we'll bring you back plenty of souvenirs from the US!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll be sure to send you pictures of the buildings and scenery we've seen, too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know I already said it once, but happy birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, it made me really happy to host your party at the cafe where I work♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I knew I had to be there the moment I heard about the venue, so I'm glad I was able to join!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. And Ena and the others said they really wanted it to be a lively party, so I'm glad we could make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For them, and for you, Yoisaki! Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And from me too! Happy birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kanade! I'm so glad we got to celebrate with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika's been in a chipper mood ever since Asahina invited us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You have. You sounded really excited when you told me about it, too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, who wouldn't be excited to celebrate a friend's birthday! Of course she'd be all chipper and cheery☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Happy birthday, Ms. Yoisaki. I'm always happy to be of help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go!
One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Ena, Mizuki & Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade.
Happy birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You talked a lot today, Kanade. And not even about music or our work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Everyone really wanted to talk to you, after all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You looked like you were having a lot of fun too, though. Should we do this again for next year's party?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Works for me! Let's get everyone together and throw a real bash!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for all the birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It feels like every birthday I have, there are more people who want to celebrate it with me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess it goes to show how many people I've been lucky enough to meet...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope I can bring these experiences and feelings through in my music, too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah... To get closer to writing a song that can save someone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Same. I'm ready to start working whenever.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But is there anything we can do?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, right.
The next song will be the one based on what Yuki told us about her family in SEKAI earlier, yeah?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, what should we do while we wait for K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I have other demos ready, so I'd appreciate it if you could all start working on those.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Let's see... Oh, here they are.
I'll send them over now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, K, I can't wait to hear how your song captures the warm memories Yuki has of her family.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Same. Still, warmth...
You could tackle that from a lot of different angles.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. Feelings and stuff are one thing, but plenty of physical objects are also warm♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <For example, the sense of relaxation that overcomes you when you dip into a warm bath.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I guess that also goes for those heated eyemasks that help with eye fatigue. I really like how warm and cozy they feel.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's like being gently wrapped in a blanket, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Can either of you come up with examples of when you feel that kind of warmth, K, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Does this have anything to do with composing?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Aww, c'mon. We did just upload a new song today. Why not relax a bit by having a chat?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, this could lead to your next great idea♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <When do I feel that sort of warmth...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I suppose when we're having a meal together, or drinking tea...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Which involves physically warm food or drinks, yes.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <In that case, what sort of warmth do you feel?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<What sort of warmth...?
When you phrase it that way, I don't really know...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, let's put it to the test!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. I also fixed myself a cup.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Why not? Maybe I just wanted to feel included.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Still, we did just pour these cups.
They're hot more than warm, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. Why don't we wait until they're just the right temperature?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, that reminds me. Do you two know what “just the right temperature” is?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yuki told me the other day.
Let's see... For warm drinks, the range is between sixty and seventy-degrees Celsius. For cold drinks, it's between five and eleven, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That's right. Apparently, those are the temperatures in which we think those drinks are the most delicious.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, really?! Also, what led to you two talking about something like that?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How did we end up on that subject...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think we were originally talking about how consuming things which are too hot or too cold isn't good for your digestive system...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <They should be the right temperature now, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think so. Why don't we try taking a sip?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, before you do, why don't you try feeling how warm your cup is first?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, me too! Ow! Oww!
Mine's still piping hot...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're kidding, right? It's been a while since we poured our tea.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's still super hot. That's the truth.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You were right, Yuki. Mine's still fairly warm too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'll try taking a sip now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What was that, Amia...?
You're doing this on purpose, aren't you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, I'm not! This really is molten hot!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Seriously...? Anyway, Yuki, K, what are your thoughts?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, and I can feel the warmth coursing through my body...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'd say this is more soothing than gentle.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Still, Mizuki was right. Taking a break was a good idea.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, the rice porridge is ready.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Alright, we can stop being watchdogs now.
Let's get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We'll do what we can on our end, Kanade, so you get as much rest as you can.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry for making you worry, Ena, Mizuki. And thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If you're really sorry, then promise to stop doing stuff like this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<What she said.
Let us know if anything else happens, Mafuyu!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I will. Anyway, I'm hanging up now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I also need to apologize to you, Rin.
Sorry for making you worry so much.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<It's okay...
For now, have some of this rice porridge.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here you are. It's still hot, so be careful.
