rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll have some now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What does rice porridge taste like, anyway?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... This one was made using eggs, so it tastes very gentle. It even brings out the sweetness in the rice.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hear that, Mafuyu...?
It sounds like she's going to finish it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You need to eat something, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll have something once I've reached a good stopping point.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I vaguely remember Mafuyu saying that I need eat something while I was working on that song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I thought I was getting enough to eat...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I ended up making Mafuyu cook this for me. The same goes for Ms. Mochizuki and her dishes. I caused them both so much trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For not eating what you made for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In retrospect, I realize that I should have made myself clearer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... She means she won't hold back next time... Right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (For a second there, it sounded like she meant something else. But I'm sure I'm just imagining things.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And I don't want Mafuyu to become stressed because of something I did...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So, I need to be more careful moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The stew Ms. Mochizuki makes has such a gentle flavor to it. I can't seem to get enough of it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, these bamboo shoots also have a nice texture to them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oops. I spilled some of my stew.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, Mafuyu, but could you hand me one of those napkins?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I was just asking if you could hand me a napkin. I accidentally spilled some of my stew...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan, I've finished checking over the rough draft of your illustration.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I like where you're going with it...
But I'd also like to focus a little more on the small details to match up with the song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay. Let me know when you're free to talk it over. I've got other things to work on in the meantime.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, Yuki, can you take a look at this asset for me? I tried finding something that matched up with your lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay. Can I do that once I've reached a good place to stop?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, no problem! Lemme send it over now!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She seems a little less preoccupied compared to when we were having dinner... Maybe because she's working with the others.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I have to think that she's anxious...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Since she'll be talking to her mom in a couple days...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And I'd be lying if I said I wasn't nervous.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I understand that not being able to see or talk to Mafuyu anymore is going to be difficult after working with her for these past two years...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'd like to take this opportunity to say...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Your little music group...
There is no room in her life for such a thing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, if you truly do care about Mafuyu, you'll ask her to leave your group.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll understand if she hears it coming from your mouth.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Back then, I was absolutely certain that Mafuyu would be crushed by her if I didn't do anything...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But Mafuyu also has warm memories about her mom.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to have faith in her mother.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And hope that she understands Mafuyu's feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That's all I can do right now.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm sorry. I haven't been able to focus on my work at all.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's okay. Your health is much more important.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What do you mean? So, you don't want to go?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The way Mafuyu reacted reminded me of...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's getting pretty late, Yuki. Why don't you take rest of the night off? We can work together some more tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Len came over a little earlier and told me about Yuki. He said she was acting strange in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, umm...
She was curled up like she was in a lot of pain...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Which is why I'm thinking about contacting her dad.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for letting me know, Len.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So... Please keep an eye on her for me...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I got a message... Oh, it's from Mr. Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I tried asking how Mafuyu and her mom are doing without mentioning what I heard yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But let's see... Huh...?
“I'm sorry for making you contact me like this. I should have reached out to you”?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
There's really no need for that.
Umm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, he's on a business trip right now, and he won't be back until... This weekend.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In that case, I'll ask to see if we can talk briefly this weekend...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: “We still haven't had a chance to properly thank you yet, so how would you feel about having dinner with us?”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That sounds perfect, since I'll also get to see Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, that'd be nice.
I was actually hoping to discuss a few things.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I hope I get to find out what's bothering Mafuyu so much...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I think the video's come together well.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<We did it!
Alright, I'll upload this right away♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for mixing this, Yuki. That helped a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That's okay. I did it because I wanted to.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<So, are we calling it a day?
It seems a little early...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
Then, why don't we start working on one of the demos we have saved up?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(We're starting to run low on demos...
I did drop everything else to work on capturing the warmth Mafuyu felt, after all.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And I've lowered my working pace ever since I collapsed a little while back...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'd rather not leave Ena and the others with nothing to do, so I might want to come up with some more.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I do want to compose that song for Mafuyu as soon as I can, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, that reminds me.
The video we uploaded the other day's been getting lots of comments.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<“This makes my chest feel tight, but I can listen to it on loop.”
“I feel like I get saved each time I listen to this song.”>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I know what they mean.
I also really love this song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It sorta hearkens back to your old ones, K. Like you understand the pain we're feeling. Like you're telling us we're not alone.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It reminded me of how I felt listening to your old songs too, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Back then, and even now...
You've always had a way of really getting the pain we're feeling.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It feels like you're reaching out a hand to save us.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Mizuki and Ena...
They both feel that way.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And all the other people who've listened to it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think I'll start working on a new song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A lot of people seem to be looking forward to our songs, and our stocks are running low. I'd rather not run out and make them wait.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, Yuki, but you're going to have to wait a little longer for that song...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I want to hear what you make next too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Because a lot of people out there need us.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And we need to save as many of them as we can, with our music.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I should suppress the bass a little more. Also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's already morning...
I am getting a bit hungry, so I think I'll have something to eat.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Instant noodles...?
No, I probably shouldn't have those for breakfast. I don't want to get scolded.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... The food Ms. Mochizuki made should be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A tablespoon of sugar and a dash of soy sauce...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Uh oh. I put in too much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But a little bit should be fine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now I just need to whisk the eggs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Next, I need to heat up the frying pan.
The one for making omelets should be... Ah, here it is.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Heat it up, pour in the eggs and lightly stir them around...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When I made those omelets for Dad and he said they were good...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh no...! I need to start rolling it before it starts clumping up...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Uh oh... It's stuck to the pan...
I can't get it unstuck...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What are you making?
Scrambled eggs?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: S-So... I was trying to make an omelet, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can you make another one, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to have breakfast, too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll handle the rice and miso soup.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you think I can actually do it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But if you want to, I think you should try.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alright, I need to crack more eggs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A piece of shell fell in.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's easy for that to happen if you crack it on the corner of something. You should try using a flat surface.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Of course. I hope you come back again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She had such a big smile on her face.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now it's our turn to have fun and pick out clothes♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't give me that, Kanade!
That's why we're here, remember?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: The fitting rooms are open, so please feel free to try on anything that catches your fancy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All of the clothes here are imbued with the designers' special feelings, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Shouldn't they be worn by people who like cute things and actually want to try them on...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Thank you for being so considerate of us, and of our clothes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: But you never know until you try, I think.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Of course, you don't have to if you don't feel comfortable. But since we have the chance, I would like to see you try some things on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But how should I even choose...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In that case, Kanade, just take a quick look around and try on the first thing that catches your eye!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The first thing that catches my eye?
That could work...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why don't you try doing the same, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you have trouble choosing, then I can give you some recommendations.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The first thing that catches my eye...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (All of these clothes are so strange, unique and interesting...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But none of them have really caught my attention...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is this a ribbon covered in flowers and lace? But it looks wide for a ribbon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, that headdress is so cute!
Great pick, Kanade! You've got good taste.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's a headdress...?
It goes on top of my head?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I was just wondering what it was.
I didn't really choose it per se...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Where'd Ena and Mizuki go?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Probably to look for clothes that go with that headdress.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade! This should go perfectly with that headdress!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I also brought something that should go well with it! See these flowers around the bust? They should really match!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which should we have her try on first?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... You got back first, Mizuki, so I wouldn't mind giving you first dibs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?
Oh, Kanade, do you have a preference?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, we'll have you try on what I found first! Here, check it out!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you really going to wear that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They did take the time to choose these for me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I can't make heads or tails of this outfit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: That's a set consisting of a blouse and dress. Let me take them off the hanger for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Sis, did the same person design the headdress Kanade found and this outfit I picked out?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. It just hit me!
They're both frilly and flowery, but they still feel refined at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: The person that designed this is a senior of mine who helps me out a lot at work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: If I recall, the idea here was to give people who aren't that fashion-conscious a nice set they can wear casually.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, you fit that bill perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's clear that the people who made all these clothes put quite a lot into them.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And Yuki said sometimes, you don't know until you try...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'll go try this on now.
I'll need a minute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, we're willing to wait as long as you need!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Want me to make some tea?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, a little break would be nice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. Let me take a sip.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All we did was go to the store and try on a few outfits, but I'm more tired than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You don't have a lot of stamina, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And... You don't usually wear things like that, after all.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's true I don't have a lot of stamina, but... I didn't dislike trying on those outfits.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I felt like a different person, in a good way. It was a nice new experience.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
So, thank you very much...
You've helped me realize something I want to cherish about myself.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: I love cute things. And cute clothes...

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: And this dress. I absolutely adore it...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad that I got to see that lady become the person that she always wanted to be.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The person that she always wanted to be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Just like music, clothes that had a lot of thought and effort put into them have a way of moving people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I mean, Yuki poured her heart into the dress that lady said she wanted to wear.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This whole trip was worth it just to see that, I think.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But thinking about designers putting their feelings into clothes made me wonder about the ones we're wearing right now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm not so sure.
The clothes you're wearing were probably mass-produced.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm inclined to agree. I did choose these sweats because I knew that I could replace them with an exact copy whenever I like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm also inclined to believe that even things like that have thoughts and feelings put into them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, what if they were designed for people who have trouble deciding what to wear each day?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But they're sweats...
They were probably designed to be quickly replaced in case you rip them or something while doing strenuous exercises.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess I'm not really living up to what the designer or manufacturer wanted from these, huh.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll do enough not to get badly out of shape, at least...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, I might take a look at the website for the company that makes these sweats.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This conversation is making me wonder what kinds of thoughts and feelings went into them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you ever wonder what people think about as they listen to N25's songs?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? I do make an effort to read through the comments...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But each person is free to think whatever they like. I just hope that they feel a little better after listening to them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Once something you made leaves your hands, what happens afterwards is entirely up to the listener.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In that case, I guess I'll stick with these sweats after all.
